project.name: tingting
project.description: TingTing — a Vietnamese trucking logistics platform structured as a pnpm monorepo: an Express 5 + TypeScript backend, a React 19 + Vite frontend styled with Tailwind CSS, and a shared package, with Drizzle ORM, JWT+Casbin RBAC, and Docker-based deployment.

nodes.name: backfill-faq-embeddings.ts
nodes.summary: One-off backfill script that embeds FAQ entries with NULL embedding vectors via OpenRouter text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) and writes them with raw SQL; idempotent and re-runnable after new FAQ rows are added.
nodes.languageNotes: Drizzle cannot express pgvector writes, so vectors are written through raw db.execute SQL literals.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Verifies database reachability, selects FAQ entries whose embedding is NULL, batches question-plus-variants text through the embedding API, and writes each vector via raw SQL UPDATE.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes the singleton postgres.js client and the Drizzle ORM instance bound to the full schema; exported as `db`, this is the database entry point for the entire backend.

nodes.name: master-data-name.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the operationalName SQL helper that prefers a master-data row's configured short name while falling back to the full legal name, keeping operational labels safe for rolling deployments and legacy writers.

nodes.name: operationalName
nodes.summary: SQL expression coalescing a trimmed short name to the full legal column for operational label queries.

nodes.name: migrate-trailers.ts
nodes.summary: One-off data migration extracting trailer plates from the trucks table into the dedicated trailers table, linking trucks via current_trailer_id and backfilling trips.trailer_id, all inside a single idempotent transaction.

nodes.name: migrateTrailers
nodes.summary: Runs the idempotent trailer extraction in one transaction: skips when trailers exist, dedupes truck trailer plates into trailers, then backfills truck and trip foreign keys via set-based SQL.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical Drizzle ORM schema defining all application tables (~170 exports), application-owned enums, indexes, checks, and a pgvector custom type — the single source of truth for the PostgreSQL database structure.
nodes.languageNotes: Enums are application-owned: PostgreSQL stores unrestricted text while TypeScript enforces the value lists, avoiding pg enum migration churn; pgvector columns are declared via a Drizzle customType.

nodes.name: applicationEnum
nodes.summary: Factory building application-owned enum columns as typed text with an attached value list, keeping enum evolution out of PostgreSQL DDL.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines ApiError, the canonical HTTP error class carrying statusCode and optional details; all services and routes throw it instead of ad-hoc error-object patterns.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: Canonical API error class extended by every backend service; the global error handler translates its statusCode and details into HTTP responses.

nodes.name: reset-seed.ts
nodes.summary: Development reset utility that clears core business tables in foreign-key-safe order (users included) and then dynamically imports the modular seed to rebuild a fresh demo database.

nodes.name: resetAndSeed
nodes.summary: Deletes trip, ledger, expense, pricing, fleet, customer, and user tables in dependency order, then dynamically imports seed.js to reseed.

nodes.name: salary.ts
nodes.summary: Express router for the salary domain: driver salary computation and confirmation, work-day batch upserts, period close/reopen/finalization governance, post-close adjustments, and payslip issuing — guarded by role checks and idempotency keys.

nodes.name: enrichSalaryWithPostCloseAdjustments
nodes.summary: Folds post-close adjustment totals into a single driver's computed salary record.

nodes.name: enrichSalaryListWithPostCloseAdjustments
nodes.summary: Batch variant that folds post-close adjustment totals into a list of driver salary records for the list endpoint.

nodes.name: registerSalaryPeriodFinalizationDecisionRoutes
nodes.summary: Registers the check/request/approve endpoints for salary-period finalization decisions, wiring material idempotency keys and expected-version guards.

nodes.name: seed-dashboard.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone dashboard seeder that populates config, reference data, multi-month synthetic trips, receivables ledger entries, and expenses so dashboard KPIs, charts, and attention-panel alerts render meaningful data; idempotent via ON CONFLICT and existence guards.

nodes.name: seedConfig
nodes.summary: Seeds road_config defaults (toll, bonuses, default driver salary) and fuel config when the tables are empty.

nodes.name: generateMonthTrips
nodes.summary: Generates a month of synthetic trips with randomized routes, customers, and VND amounts for dashboard chart volume.

nodes.name: seedTrips
nodes.summary: Inserts generated trips across months with per-trip duplicate guards so re-runs stay idempotent.

nodes.name: insertLedgerEntry
nodes.summary: Inserts one ledger transaction row tied to a customer, trip, and dated entry.

nodes.name: seedReceivables
nodes.summary: Seeds PAYMENT_RECEIVED and overdue ledger entries to populate AR aging widgets.

nodes.name: seedExpenses
nodes.summary: Seeds vendor and fuel expenses with varied approval states across trips for payables and expense views.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the dashboard seed — config, reference data, trips, receivables, expenses — and reports completion.

nodes.name: seed.ts
nodes.summary: Main database seeder orchestrating the full demo dataset: hashed demo users, customers, reference and pricing data, fleet, ports, operational sites, dispatch-chain trips, vendor financials, forwarder money flows, and customer AR; also exposes clerk-scope and shipment seeding helpers.

nodes.name: seed
nodes.summary: Primary orchestration that hashes demo passwords and runs every domain seeder in dependency order — identity, customers, reference/pricing, fleet, ports, sites, dispatch-chain trips, vendor financials, forwarder money, and customer AR.

nodes.name: seedClerkScope
nodes.summary: Seeds the clerk workflow surface — shipments and container data scoped to clerk demo accounts.

nodes.name: resolveSeedReferenceIds
nodes.summary: Resolves seeded reference rows into id lookup maps consumed by downstream seeders.

nodes.name: seedShipments
nodes.summary: Seeds customer shipments end-to-end through the shipment service: creation, status transitions, container batch upserts, and attached documents.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting all static seed datasets — customers, drivers, fleet, reference, pricing, samples, factories, vehicles — plus the Excel-derived ports list.

nodes.name: ports-from-excel.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated static dataset of Vietnamese port/yard entries (name, address, operation URL, lifting fee) extracted from the customer's DATA PM Excel workbook; regenerable via tools/generate-seed-data.mjs.

nodes.name: seed-customer-ar.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the customer accounts-receivable chain through domain services: e-POD submissions on completed trips, a governed debit-note issue for one customer, and a payment receipt with per-trip allocations.

nodes.name: minimalPdf
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal valid single-page PDF buffer used as demo POD and document attachments.

nodes.name: seedCustomerAr
nodes.summary: Entry point sequencing the AR chain: e-POD on completed trips, then debit-note issue, then payment receipt with allocations.

nodes.name: seedDebitNote
nodes.summary: Generates and saves a debit-note draft for a billed customer via the billing-document service, exercising the ISSUE governance path.

nodes.name: seedPaymentReceipt
nodes.summary: Records a customer payment receipt with per-trip allocations to produce PAYMENT_RECEIVED ledger entries.

nodes.name: seed-customers.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds customers, partner records, and linked suppliers from the customer Excel THÔNG TIN NCC data, plus Silver Sea company-identity app settings and the 21-column Long Minh debit-note template.

nodes.name: seedCustomers
nodes.summary: Upserts customers, partners, and linked suppliers keyed by normalized tax code, returning an internal-code-to-customerId map for downstream seeders.

nodes.name: seedCompanySettings
nodes.summary: Writes the Silver Sea company identity into app_settings so exports carry the real issuer.

nodes.name: seedLongMinhDebitTemplate
nodes.summary: Seeds the Long Minh debit-note template with grouped service-fee and recoverable-expense columns matching the customer's real export layout.

nodes.name: seed-factories.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds Excel-derived factories and warehouses as operational sites referenced by shipment intake's pickup-point dropdowns; idempotent via normalized-name matching.

nodes.name: seedFactories
nodes.summary: Upserts Excel-derived factories/warehouses as operational sites with address and contact details, skipping rows that already match by normalized name.

nodes.name: seed-fleet.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the fleet from the customer Excel roster — trucks by plate (BKS), trailers, and drivers — matching trucks to their named drivers via accent-insensitive name normalization.

nodes.name: normName
nodes.summary: Normalizes Vietnamese names by stripping diacritics and lowercasing for fuzzy driver-name matching.

nodes.name: seedFleet
nodes.summary: Upserts trucks by plate and drivers from the roster, matching trucks to named drivers and returning plate/name-to-id maps.

nodes.name: seed-forwarder-money.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds forwarder (OPS) money flows through the advance domain services: advance requests in all decision states with OPS_ADVANCE ledger entries, plus one settlement linking approved advances to their expenses.

nodes.name: seedForwarderMoney
nodes.summary: Coordinates forwarder money seeding: pending/approved/rejected advance requests plus one linked advance settlement.

nodes.name: seedAdvances
nodes.summary: Creates advance requests in PENDING, APPROVED (with OPS_ADVANCE ledger effect), and REJECTED states through the advance service.

nodes.name: seedSettlement
nodes.summary: Creates an advance settlement linking approved advances and their expenses through the domain service.

nodes.name: seed-identity.ts
nodes.summary: Shared idempotency helpers for the seed suite: text normalization plus SQL equality expressions for matching existing rows case- and whitespace-insensitively (NULL-safe variant included).

nodes.name: normalizeSeedText
nodes.summary: Trims and lowercases seed text into its canonical matching form.

nodes.name: normalizedTextEquals
nodes.summary: SQL predicate comparing a column against normalized seed text via lower(btrim(...)).

nodes.name: normalizedNullableTextEquals
nodes.summary: NULL-safe equality treating empty strings and missing values as equal for idempotent seed lookups.

nodes.name: seed-lift-pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds container lift-on/lift-off (nâng/hạ) pricing per port and container size, keyed off the reference seed results.

nodes.name: seedLiftPricing
nodes.summary: Upserts lift pricing rows for each port/container-type combination using reference-seed id maps, skipping existing rows.

nodes.name: seed-operational-sites.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds customer-owned operational sites (factories and pickup warehouses) linked by stable tax code so shipment-intake dropdowns are populated; built to close the empty-dropdown intake bug.

nodes.name: seedOperationalSites
nodes.summary: Upserts realistic Vietnamese factory/warehouse sites with contacts and addresses, keyed by customer tax code for idempotent re-runs.

nodes.name: seed-ports.ts
nodes.summary: Upserts ports/terminals from the Excel-derived port dataset so shipment forms' port/yard dropdown holds real Vietnamese port entries.

nodes.name: seedPorts
nodes.summary: Inserts Excel-derived ports with address, operation URL, and lifting fee, skipping ports already present by normalized name.

nodes.name: seed-pricing-tables.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the customer-provided freight-price matrix as explicit pricing-table classes for the Long Minh customer with a fixed effective date.

nodes.name: seedPricingTables
nodes.summary: Creates pricing-table rows linking the Long Minh customer to route/container-type prices, using reference and customer seed maps.

nodes.name: seed-reference.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds core reference data — ports, routes, cargo types, container types — returning name/code-to-id lookup maps consumed by the pricing, lift-pricing, and trip seeders.

nodes.name: seedReference
nodes.summary: Upserts ports, routes (from the pricing-grid structure), cargo types, and container sizes, returning lookup maps for downstream seeders.

nodes.name: seed-sample-pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds freight pricing for the demo sample customers across the three seeded routes so trip creation resolves non-zero TABLE revenue, which the debit-note/AR chain derives from.

nodes.name: seedSamplePricing
nodes.summary: Upserts (customer, route, container_type, effective_date)-keyed pricing rows for sample customers, idempotently skipping existing entries.

nodes.name: seed-trips.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds trips through the real dispatch chain — carrier assignment, handoff acceptance, dispatch-order issue, status transitions, forwarder expenses, and e-POD submissions — so dispatch and ops screens hold production-shaped data; idempotent and self-satisfying its own prerequisites.

nodes.name: resolveSeedActors
nodes.summary: Resolves demo actor user ids (CUS, dispatcher, manager, accountant) by username at runtime for dispatch-chain seeding.

nodes.name: ensureTrailers
nodes.summary: Guarantees one ACTIVE trailer per ACTIVE 60C truck — a dispatch precondition — creating placeholders idempotently.

nodes.name: ensureDriverUserLinks
nodes.summary: Links driver rows to their ACTIVE user accounts, which dispatch validation requires.

nodes.name: ensureExternalCarrier
nodes.summary: Ensures an ACTIVE carrier customer plus fleet vehicles required for EXTERNAL dispatch, creating them when missing.

nodes.name: seedTrips
nodes.summary: Drives READY_FOR_DISPATCH shipments through the real dispatch chain — carrier assignment, handoff acceptance, dispatch-order issue, IN_TRANSIT/COMPLETED transitions, forwarder expenses, and e-POD submissions — skipping shipments that already have live trips.

nodes.name: seed-vehicles-from-excel.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds truck/trailer combinations from the customer Excel vehicle-type sheet (LOẠI HÌNH XE), linking drivers where roster names resolve.

nodes.name: seedVehiclesFromExcel
nodes.summary: Upserts trucks with their trailer pairings from the Excel dataset, linking drivers by normalized name where resolvable.

nodes.name: seed-vendor-financials.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds vendor-side financials through domain services: company expenses producing VENDOR ledger payables, and approved fuel invoices with per-trip allocations for fuel reconciliation.

nodes.name: seedVendorFinancials
nodes.summary: Entry point seeding vendor-side financials: company expenses and approved fuel invoices with trip allocations.

nodes.name: seedCompanyExpenses
nodes.summary: Creates company expenses through the expense service, producing VENDOR ledger payables for the payables and expenses views.

nodes.name: seedFuelInvoices
nodes.summary: Creates fuel invoices with per-trip allocations and approves them for fuel-recon reporting.

nodes.name: wipe.ts
nodes.summary: Wipe utility that TRUNCATEs all business tables in one CASCADE statement while contractually preserving user accounts, push subscriptions, agent/FAQ/knowledge, and idempotency tables; exposes the table list, a dry-run plan, and an executor.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on Postgres TRUNCATE ... CASCADE to resolve FK order rather than manual sequencing; the explicit table list is the source of truth kept in sync with schema.ts.

nodes.name: wipeTableList
nodes.summary: Returns the flat wipe-list table names for dry-run output and tooling.

nodes.name: planWipe
nodes.summary: Computes the wipe plan (statement plus table list) without executing anything, for dry runs.

nodes.name: executeWipe
nodes.summary: Executes the TRUNCATE ... CASCADE wipe of business tables inside a transaction while preserving auth tables.

nodes.name: adjustment-governance.service.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the trip financial governance workflow — requesting and approving AR adjustments, financial closes/changes, completed-trip cancellations, and reopens — with a central apply dispatcher that orchestrates ledger postings, billing deltas, work-day sync, notifications, and GPS capture across 26 collaborating services.

nodes.name: assertTripCanBeReopened
nodes.summary: Validates that a completed trip is eligible for reopen: close readiness, period locks, ledger state, and pending governance checks.

nodes.name: requestTripArAdjustment
nodes.summary: Opens a governed AR-adjustment request for a trip, validating reason, expected version, and ledger preconditions.

nodes.name: requestTripReopen
nodes.summary: Opens a governed reopen request for a closed trip after verifying reopen eligibility.

nodes.name: assertNoPendingTripGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Rejects new governance requests when an active action already exists for the trip and version.

nodes.name: requestTripFinancialClose
nodes.summary: Opens the governed trip financial-close request, enforcing close readiness and period authority.

nodes.name: requestTripFinancialChange
nodes.summary: Opens a governed post-close financial change request for an already-closed trip.

nodes.name: requestCompletedTripCancellation
nodes.summary: Opens the governed cancellation flow for completed trips, which on approval unwinds ledger entries, work days, and billing documents.

nodes.name: approveGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Approves a pending trip governance action inside a transaction, delegating to the action-kind applier.

nodes.name: applyGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Applies an approved action through the generic adapter, asserting the active approval application.

nodes.name: applyTripGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Central dispatcher executing each trip governance action kind — AR adjustments, closes, changes, cancellations — orchestrating ledger postings, billing deltas, work days, notifications, GPS capture jobs, and profitability snapshots.

nodes.name: listTripGovernanceActions
nodes.summary: Lists governance actions for a trip, newest first.

nodes.name: advance.service.ts
nodes.summary: Complete forwarder advance domain: create/approve/reject advance requests, create/check/approve settlements, auto-offset approved expenses against outstanding advances, and post-close corrections and reversals — with optimistic versioning, governance hooks, and OPS ledger integration.

nodes.name: expenseSnapshot
nodes.summary: Projects a trip expense into a comparable snapshot of type, amounts, and document references.

nodes.name: generateSettlementCode
nodes.summary: Generates the next sequential settlement code inside the caller's transaction.

nodes.name: enrichWithNames
nodes.summary: Joins forwarder and creator display names onto advance and settlement rows.

nodes.name: enrichSettlementWithRequests
nodes.summary: Loads and attaches the advance requests backing a settlement for detail views.

nodes.name: createAdvanceRequest
nodes.summary: Creates a forwarder advance request row in PENDING status.

nodes.name: listAdvanceRequests
nodes.summary: Lists advance requests with forwarder and status filters.

nodes.name: getAdvanceRequestCounts
nodes.summary: Computes per-status counts of a forwarder's advance requests.

nodes.name: getAdvanceRequest
nodes.summary: Fetches a single advance request by id.

nodes.name: requestAdvanceRequestApprovalGovernance
nodes.summary: Opens a governed approval request for an advance, validating policy evidence and expected version.

nodes.name: requestAdvanceRequestRejectionGovernance
nodes.summary: Opens a governed rejection request for a pending advance.

nodes.name: approveAdvanceRequest
nodes.summary: Approves an advance request: writes OPS_ADVANCE ledger entries and emits notifications under a version guard.

nodes.name: rejectAdvanceRequest
nodes.summary: Rejects a pending advance request with reason and notification.

nodes.name: applyAdvanceRequestGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Applies an approved advance-request governance action inside the transaction.

nodes.name: createAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Creates a settlement linking a forwarder's approved advances and expenses, validating inputs and computing balances.

nodes.name: autoOffsetExpenseApproval
nodes.summary: Automatically applies approved expenses against outstanding advances, generating offset ledger entries when the forwarder's balance allows.

nodes.name: listAdvanceSettlements
nodes.summary: Lists settlements with filters, forwarder names, and request enrichment.

nodes.name: getAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Loads one settlement with its requests and display names for detail views.

nodes.name: assertSettlementBalanced
nodes.summary: Validates that settlement advances equal applied amounts before state transitions.

nodes.name: updateAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Updates a PENDING settlement's links and amounts under optimistic version locking.

nodes.name: checkAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Accountant check step that freezes settlement inputs before approval.

nodes.name: approveAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Approves a checked settlement: posts OPS_SETTLEMENT ledger entries, updates expense completion, emits notifications, and finalizes balances.

nodes.name: adjustSettlementExpense
nodes.summary: Post-approval correction path adjusting one expense inside an approved settlement with governance and ledger compensation.

nodes.name: requestAdvanceSettlementReversal
nodes.summary: Opens a governed reversal request for an approved settlement.

nodes.name: applyApprovedSettlementCorrection
nodes.summary: Applies an approved settlement correction: recalculates amounts, rewrites ledger entries, and rebalances the settlement.

nodes.name: applyApprovedSettlementReversal
nodes.summary: Reverses an approved settlement's ledger effects and restores expense states.

nodes.name: applyAdvanceSettlementGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Routes settlement governance actions to the correction or reversal appliers.

nodes.name: rejectAdvanceSettlement
nodes.summary: Rejects a pending or checked settlement with reason and notification.

nodes.name: getOutstandingAdvanceBalance
nodes.summary: Computes one forwarder's outstanding advance balance (approved advances minus settled amounts).

nodes.name: getOutstandingAdvanceBalances
nodes.summary: Computes outstanding advance balances across all forwarders.

nodes.name: ap-aging.service.ts
nodes.summary: Per-supplier accounts-payable aging detail with FIFO buckets, partial-payment splits, duplicate receipt-ref detection, and overpayment surfacing — the AP mirror of the customer AR aging list.

nodes.name: getApAgingDetail
nodes.summary: Builds the per-supplier AP aging report: payable vs paid splits, current/30/60/90+ buckets, duplicate VENDOR_PAYMENT receipt-ref flags, and overpayment (supplier credit) totals.

nodes.name: ap-snapshot.service.ts
nodes.summary: Trip-level AP snapshot service that hashes approved payable expenses, captures versioned snapshots, marks them dirty on source change, and recaptures under trip financial authority locks.

nodes.name: collectApPayableExpenses
nodes.summary: Filters approved COMPANY_DIRECT expenses with a supplier and positive buy amount into a deterministic payable set.

nodes.name: computeApHash
nodes.summary: Computes a stable content hash over a trip's payable expenses to detect snapshot drift.

nodes.name: ApSnapshotService
nodes.summary: Service capturing trip AP snapshots, marking them dirty when source expenses change, listing dirty trips, and recapturing under trip financial authority locks.

nodes.name: application-owned-uniqueness.service.ts
nodes.summary: Provides Postgres advisory transaction locks that serialize application-owned uniqueness constraints (scope + parts) where dedicated unique indexes are not expressible.
nodes.languageNotes: Composite keys are serialized with a unit-separator delimiter and locked via pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(key, 0)) — the xact variant auto-releases at commit/rollback.

nodes.name: lockApplicationOwnedUniqueness
nodes.summary: Acquires a Postgres advisory transaction lock for one application-owned uniqueness scope.

nodes.name: lockApplicationOwnedUniquenessSet
nodes.summary: Acquires sorted, deduplicated advisory locks for a set of uniqueness scopes in deterministic order.

nodes.name: application-relationship.service.ts
nodes.summary: Central row-locking helpers for application-owned relationships: lock active customers, business units, shipments, users, drivers, fleet, and suppliers in deterministic order to serialize dependent mutations.

nodes.name: lockActiveCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Locks active customer rows for update within a transaction, rejecting missing or inactive customers.

nodes.name: lockActiveBusinessUnitIds
nodes.summary: Locks active business-unit rows for update, validating existence.

nodes.name: lockShipmentRows
nodes.summary: Locks shipment rows in id order to serialize dependent mutations.

nodes.name: lockUserRowForUpdate
nodes.summary: Locks a user row for update with a customizable not-found error.

nodes.name: lockDriverRowForUpdate
nodes.summary: Locks a driver row for update with a customizable not-found error.

nodes.name: lockTruckRow
nodes.summary: Locks a truck row in share or update mode, tolerating missing rows when allowed.

nodes.name: lockTrailerRow
nodes.summary: Locks a trailer row in share or update mode with optional missing-row tolerance.

nodes.name: lockSupplierRow
nodes.summary: Locks a supplier row in share or update mode with optional missing-row tolerance.

nodes.name: cascadeDeleteUserLinks
nodes.summary: Deletes rows linking a user across role tables when the user is removed.

nodes.name: approval.service.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the expense approval state machine and its governance hooks: transitioning approvals, processing expense approval decisions, and applying governed decisions to trip expenses.

nodes.name: transitionApproval
nodes.summary: Core approval state machine that walks an approval record through its lifecycle, validating permitted transitions and persisting the decision with its side effects in one transaction.

nodes.name: processExpenseApproval
nodes.summary: Processes an expense approval decision end-to-end, delegating to transitionApproval under the trip financial authority lock and firing downstream propagation hooks.

nodes.name: requestTripExpenseDecision
nodes.summary: Creates a governance action requesting an approve/reject decision on a trip expense, capturing required policy evidence and the no-invoice disbursement review snapshot.

nodes.name: applyTripExpenseGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Applies an approved governance decision to a trip expense by invoking the approval adapter and propagating the source change to dependent financial records.

nodes.name: ar-snapshot.service.ts
nodes.summary: Snapshots trip financial state for AR reporting, hashing cost components to detect drift between snapshot time and reporting time within a transactional service class.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports a class ArSnapshotService with private helpers plus a module-level computeCostHash, a hybrid OO/procedural layout common in this codebase's financial services.

nodes.name: computeCostHash
nodes.summary: Computes a stable hash over a trip's cost components so callers can detect whether underlying financial data changed after a snapshot was taken.

nodes.name: ArSnapshotService
nodes.summary: Service class that loads trip financial state, captures AR snapshots under the trip financial authority lock, and validates snapshot freshness via cost hashes.

nodes.name: ar-split-report.service.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the AR split report that breaks customer receivables into aging/current buckets directly from ledger and billing document tables.

nodes.name: getArSplitReport
nodes.summary: Aggregates customer receivable balances into the AR split report shape, grouping ledger rows by aging bucket and returning per-customer totals.

nodes.name: ar-status.service.ts
nodes.summary: Computes accounts-receivable status for individual trips and per-customer summaries, resolving due dates through the business calendar and customer receivable authority rules.

nodes.name: getTripArStatus
nodes.summary: Resolves the full AR status of a trip: receivable amount, due date, paid/allocated amounts, overdue days, and dispute state, reconciling billing documents with ledger postings.

nodes.name: getCustomerArSummary
nodes.summary: Rolls up AR status across all of a customer's trips into a summary with totals, overdue amounts, and worst-case aging.

nodes.name: attendance.service.ts
nodes.summary: Manages driver attendance and salary computation: work-day CRUD and trip synchronization, attendance summaries, salary calculation from work days and trips, and salary confirmation lifecycle.

nodes.name: getWorkDays
nodes.summary: Lists a driver's work days for a month range with optional filtering.

nodes.name: upsertWorkDay
nodes.summary: Creates or updates a single driver work-day record under the application-owned uniqueness lock, normalizing dates and detecting duplicates.

nodes.name: deleteWorkDay
nodes.summary: Deletes a work-day record by id after ownership validation.

nodes.name: batchUpsertWorkDays
nodes.summary: Atomically upserts a batch of work days in one transaction, rejecting overlapping duplicates and preserving per-row salary impacts.

nodes.name: syncTripWorkDays
nodes.summary: Reconciles work days derived from a trip's schedule against manually entered work days, keeping trip-linked attendance in sync after trip changes.

nodes.name: removeTripWorkDays
nodes.summary: Removes trip-derived work days when a trip no longer covers them.

nodes.name: computeAttendanceSummary
nodes.summary: Summarizes a driver's monthly attendance: standard work days, actual worked days, Sundays, absences, and leave counts.

nodes.name: getSalaryConfirmationRecord
nodes.summary: Loads the salary confirmation record for a driver and period, including its current governance status.

nodes.name: computeSalary
nodes.summary: Computes a driver's monthly salary from base salary, attendance summary, and per-trip earnings, applying deductions and rounding rules.

nodes.name: computeAllDriverSalaries
nodes.summary: Batch-computes salaries for all active drivers for a period, skipping drivers without confirmations where policy requires.

nodes.name: confirmSalary
nodes.summary: Confirms a computed salary for a driver and period, locking the salary confirmation against further silent changes.

nodes.name: unconfirmSalary
nodes.summary: Reopens a confirmed salary by unconfirming the record, re-enabling edits after governance checks.

nodes.name: audit-query.service.ts
nodes.summary: Queries and shapes audit-log views for different roles, building dynamic filter conditions (finance domain, accountant assignment) and redacting payloads for accountant visibility.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw Drizzle sql fragments as composable condition builders (eventSql, entityTypeSql, pathPrefixSql) — a pattern shared across this codebase's reporting services.

nodes.name: accountantAssignmentCondition
nodes.summary: Builds the visibility condition restricting accountants to audit entries about customers/shipments they are assigned to, joining assignment tables into an OR condition tree.

nodes.name: redactPayloadForAccountant
nodes.summary: Strips sensitive top-level payload fields before an audit entry is returned to an accountant.

nodes.name: classifyAuditCategory
nodes.summary: Maps an audit-log entity type and path to a user-facing category label.

nodes.name: queryAuditLogs
nodes.summary: Main entry point: paginates and filters audit logs per the viewer's role, applying accountant scope conditions, redaction, and category classification.

nodes.name: billing-document-governance.service.ts
nodes.summary: Governance layer for billing documents: requesting adjustments and issue actions, detecting source drift between documents and their trip/expense sources, and applying governed transitions.

nodes.name: loadCurrentTripSource
nodes.summary: Loads the current rendered state of a trip source row so governance can compare it against the version captured in the billing document.

nodes.name: loadCurrentExpenseSource
nodes.summary: Loads the current rendered state of an expense source row for drift comparison against the document's captured version.

nodes.name: buildSourceDiffs
nodes.summary: Diffs the current trip/expense sources against the snapshots stored in the billing document lines, producing human-readable change records.

nodes.name: captureIssueSourceSnapshots
nodes.summary: Persists immutable source snapshots when an issue governance action is created, so later reviews see exactly what was disputed.

nodes.name: agentSocket.ts
nodes.summary: Real-time socket.io transport for the AI command-and-insight assistant: mounts the /agent namespace on the Express HTTP server, authenticates the JWT handshake, rate-limits turns, and routes each message through intent classification into FAQ/lookup/summary/financial-overview/deterministic-report lanes.

nodes.languageNotes: Policy is loaded once at process boot; under tsx watch, policy.csv edits require a process restart to take effect.

nodes.name: initEnforcer
nodes.summary: Builds the Casbin enforcer from model.conf and policy.csv, caches it as the module singleton, and returns it.

nodes.name: index.ts

nodes.name: index.ts

nodes.name: readSamplerRatio
nodes.summary: Parses the trace sampler ratio (0..1) from OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG with a safe default.

nodes.name: startSdk
nodes.summary: Assembles resource, exporter, sampler, and auto-instrumentations into a NodeSDK and starts tracing, with console diagnostics.

nodes.name: validation.ts
nodes.summary: Converts a failed Zod parse into a 400 ApiError with a 'message (field)' shape consistent with the global error handler.

nodes.name: throwValidation
nodes.summary: Throws a formatted ApiError from a ZodError, joining field paths into the message and detail string.

nodes.name: asyncHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Express wrapper that catches promise rejections from async route handlers and forwards them to the global error handler.

nodes.name: asyncHandler
nodes.summary: Wraps an async request handler so a rejected promise is routed through next(err) instead of crashing the request.

nodes.name: audit.ts
nodes.summary: Audit-logging middleware that maps mutating requests to registered audit events, sanitizes payloads, runs handlers inside an audit request context, and persists material-write audit outcomes (success, conflict, failure) transactionally.
nodes.languageNotes: Audit persistence failure fails the request with a Vietnamese user-facing message, making the audit trail a hard invariant rather than best-effort logging.

nodes.name: auditLogMiddleware
nodes.summary: Intercepts mutating responses, resolves the audit event for the method+path, records request metadata and sanitized body, and schedules durable audit persistence tied to the response outcome.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: JWT authentication middleware: verifies the bearer token against the Redis blacklist, loads the user with role and customer scope, detects token/customer-scope drift, and attaches req.user for downstream handlers; also provides a signed-URL asset variant and the getUser accessor.

nodes.name: loadCurrentCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Loads the user's current customer links from the database so freshly linked or unlinked accounts invalidate tokens carrying stale customer scopes.

nodes.name: sameCustomerScope
nodes.summary: Compares the token's embedded customer ids against the database's current set to reject tokens issued before a scope change.

nodes.name: authMiddleware
nodes.summary: Verifies the JWT (signature, expiry, blacklist, customer-scope freshness) and attaches the AuthUser to req.user, or responds 401.

nodes.name: assetAuthMiddleware
nodes.summary: Authenticates signed-URL asset requests (photos/downloads) with the same token checks as authMiddleware but tolerant of header-less access.

nodes.name: getUser
nodes.summary: Type-safe accessor that returns req.user or throws when a handler runs without authentication.

nodes.name: casbin.ts
nodes.summary: Authorization middleware translating HTTP methods to Casbin actions (read/write/delete) against route-scoped resources, plus requireRoles for hard role gates and tripRouteAuthz for trip-scoped checks.
nodes.languageNotes: requireRoles REPLACES the subject's role set rather than stacking with casbinAuthz — stacking the two previously caused 403s for admins.

nodes.name: hasRouteScopedRoleAllowance
nodes.summary: Checks route-scoped Casbin allowances (e.g. DISPATCHER POST on specific catalogs) that supplement the base role policy.

nodes.name: requireRoles
nodes.summary: Returns middleware that admits only the listed roles, replacing any broader allowance for that route.

nodes.name: casbinAuthz
nodes.summary: Resource-scoped authorization factory: maps the request method to a Casbin action and enforces policy for the given resource name.

nodes.name: tripRouteAuthz
nodes.summary: Specialized authorization for trip routes that enforces per-trip ownership rules on top of role policy.

nodes.name: errorHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Global Express error handler that converts ApiError and unexpected errors into consistent JSON responses, hides internals in production, and logs stack traces.

nodes.name: globalErrorHandler
nodes.summary: Terminal Express error middleware: picks status and message from ApiError, falls back to 500 with a generic message in production, and includes Zod-style details when present.

nodes.name: forwarder.ts
nodes.summary: Middleware that resolves the OPS/forwarder profile for the authenticated user and attaches it to req.forwarder, avoiding repeated lookups per handler.

nodes.name: resolveForwarder
nodes.summary: Loads the forwarder profile by user id and stores it on req.forwarder, surfacing 404 through NoForwarderProfileError when no OPS profile exists.

nodes.name: material-write.ts
nodes.summary: Registry and matcher that declares which mutating endpoints are 'material writes' (idempotency-keyed, audited) — generated from CRUD specs plus explicit custom rules — and resolves the material-write context for a request.
nodes.languageNotes: A single declarative registry feeds idempotency replay, durable audit outcomes, and an exhaustive test that fails when an endpoint is missing — one source of truth for write safety.

nodes.name: createCrudMaterialWriteRules
nodes.summary: Builds POST/PUT/DELETE material-write rules with path regexes from a CRUD base-path/resource spec.

nodes.name: listDeclaredMaterialWriteEndpoints
nodes.summary: Returns all declared material-write endpoint identifiers, consumed by the exhaustive registry test.

nodes.name: matchDeclaredMaterialWrite
nodes.summary: Matches a method+raw path against the declared rules to find the material-write endpoint id for a request.

nodes.name: getMaterialWriteContext
nodes.summary: Extracts the material-write context (endpoint id, idempotency key, actor) for a request, used by audit persistence.

nodes.name: admin-gps.ts
nodes.summary: Admin GPS endpoints to backfill and recapture real-route GPS trails after Google Directions retirement: durable, idempotent commands with lease-based concurrency, attempt snapshots, and material-write audit outcomes.
nodes.languageNotes: Commands follow a PENDING → EFFECT_APPLIED → SUCCEEDED/FAILED snapshot state machine with a 2-minute lease, so a crashed capture can be safely retried or observed.

nodes.name: captureAndDeriveTripGps
nodes.summary: Captures a trip's GPS track and derives its map route, returning the per-trip capture result.

nodes.name: selectBackfillTripIds
nodes.summary: Selects the trips eligible for GPS backfill based on date range and missing-track criteria.

nodes.name: runDurableGpsCommand
nodes.summary: Executes a durable GPS command (backfill or recapture): claims a lease, records attempt snapshots, applies the effect per trip, persists success/conflict/attempt audits, and finalizes the command status.

nodes.name: createAdminGpsRouter
nodes.summary: Builds the admin GPS router exposing status, backfill, and recapture endpoints wired to the durable command runner.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: REST surface for the AI assistant's conversation history (list conversations, fetch one thread); live chat streams over socket.io in agentSocket.ts, and every route returns 503 while the bot feature flag is off.

nodes.name: app-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Governed app-settings router: reads/writes the singleton settings record with optimistic version checks, routes financial-policy changes through the price-config governance workflow, and manages masked email-provider settings with idempotent writes.

nodes.name: requireIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Rejects mutating requests that lack an Idempotency-Key header with a 400.

nodes.name: parseExpectedUpdatedAt
nodes.summary: Parses the optimistic-concurrency expected-version header into a timestamp.

nodes.name: assertOptionalVersion
nodes.summary: Compares an optional expected version against the current row and throws a conflict error on mismatch.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Authentication and user-management router: login with audit and rate awareness, logout with token blacklisting, profile and password change, plus admin-governed user and business-unit CRUD with optimistic locking and idempotent commands.

nodes.name: blacklistCurrentToken
nodes.summary: Extracts the caller's JWT id and adds it to the Redis blacklist for logout/revocation.

nodes.name: revokeCurrentTokenOrThrow
nodes.summary: Revokes the current session's token, surfacing a conflict error if the token is already revoked.

nodes.name: lockUserVersion
nodes.summary: Row-locks a user inside a transaction and verifies its version matches the expected optimistic-concurrency value.

nodes.name: lockBusinessUnitVersion
nodes.summary: Row-locks a business unit in a transaction with the same optimistic-version check as lockUserVersion.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Master configuration router (2400 lines): CRUD for every operational catalog (customers, trucks, trailers, routes, pricing, fuel, suppliers, tires, salary periods, business calendar) via crud-factory plus hand-written governed endpoints, catalog bootstrap, tire lifecycle, salary-period admin, audit-log query, and master-data import mounting.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes generated CRUD routers (createCrudRouter) with transactional hand-rolled handlers where catalog invariants — unique codes, single defaults, cross-row mirrors — exceed what the factory can enforce atomically.

nodes.name: lockCatalogRelationship
nodes.summary: Row-locks a catalog row inside a transaction to serialize concurrent relationship updates.

nodes.name: requireActiveCatalogRow
nodes.summary: Fetches an active (non-deleted) catalog row inside a transaction or throws a 404 ApiError.

nodes.name: assertUniqueCatalogString
nodes.summary: Enforces uniqueness of a catalog string field (code, tax code) inside a transaction, including soft-delete awareness.

nodes.name: lockCustomerMutationKeys
nodes.summary: Locks the uniqueness keys a customer mutation depends on so concurrent writes cannot produce duplicate codes or tax codes.

nodes.name: markCompletedFuelSurchargeTripsDirty
nodes.summary: Flags completed trips for fuel-surcharge recomputation after a fuel config change.

nodes.name: requireExpectedUpdatedAt
nodes.summary: Requires the optimistic-concurrency version header on mutating requests.

nodes.name: assertGovernedSnapshotUnchanged
nodes.summary: Detects lost updates on governed resources by comparing the pre-read fingerprint against the current row state before applying a decision.

nodes.name: normalizeSupplierPayload
nodes.summary: Normalizes supplier create/update payloads: type classification, fuel flags, and deduplicated fields.

nodes.name: normalizeForwarderExpenseTypePayload
nodes.summary: Normalizes forwarder expense-type payloads including no-invoice approval policy defaults and evidence type sets.

nodes.name: withForwarderExpenseTypePolicyVersion
nodes.summary: Applies forwarder expense-type changes under a governed policy version, bumping the version and invalidating caches transactionally.

nodes.name: portalBootstrap
nodes.summary: Shapes the bootstrap payload for customer-portal users, exposing only portal-visible catalogs.

nodes.name: clerkBootstrap
nodes.summary: Shapes the bootstrap payload for clerk-scoped users, filtering catalogs to the clerk's responsible unit.

nodes.name: debit-note-templates.routes.ts

nodes.name: clearOtherDefaults

nodes.name: driver-user-binding.routes.ts

nodes.name: master-data-import.routes.ts

nodes.name: pricing-tables-governed.routes.ts

nodes.name: driver.ts

nodes.summary: Wraps a mutating driver handler so its outcome is recorded under the material-write audit context.

nodes.name: acquireExpenseCleanupGuard

nodes.name: releaseExpenseCleanupGuard

nodes.summary: Requires the Idempotency-Key header on fuel-invoice mutations.

nodes.name: ledger.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Ledger routes serving paginated account entries, entity balances, and customer statement exports in JSON, XLSX, and printable HTML formats.

nodes.name: payments.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Largest financial route file: payment receipts, vendor/carrier payments, adjustments, commissions, driver payouts, supplier/carrier payable statements, profit distribution, and the full treasury account/cutover/reversal lifecycle, all wrapped in governance and idempotency.

nodes.name: penalties.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Driver penalty routes: filtered listing plus idempotent create and cancel commands that route through governance approval for financial roles.

nodes.summary: Financial reporting endpoints: executive dashboard, approval queue, P&L, profitability attribution, receivables summary and aging exports, fuel variance, distribution history, payment-term evaluation, and profit-distribution preview/execution.

nodes.summary: Admin OCR settings endpoints (GET/PUT) managing the vision provider and encrypted API key with masked read-back, optimistic-lock updatedAt enforcement, and idempotent updates.

nodes.name: assertOcrRecognitionEnabled

nodes.name: toCustomerShipmentDetail
nodes.summary: Projects shipment detail into the customer-visible shape, exposing only customer-relevant status, containers, and milestones.

nodes.name: resolveSelectedCustomerId
