nodes.summary: Deterministic (non-LLM) agent lane that renders the monthly P&L plus receivables and payables summaries straight from the reporting services as VND-formatted Vietnamese markdown.

nodes.name: runDeterministicReport
nodes.summary: Computes a period-resolved P&L report plus receivables/payables aging summaries and formats them into a Vietnamese markdown insight response without calling the LLM.

nodes.name: faq-fast-lane.ts
nodes.summary: FAQ fast path for the agent: tries exact normalized-question matches against faqEntries, then pgvector semantic search with a score floor and margin, skipping the LLM entirely on a confident hit.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-stage match: exact normalized equality first, then pgvector cosine similarity gated by SCORE_FLOOR/MARGIN acceptance thresholds; query embeddings are cached in Redis.

nodes.name: tryExactMatch
nodes.summary: Loads active FAQ entries and checks each question and its variants for an exact normalized match against the query.

nodes.name: trySemanticMatch
nodes.summary: Embeds the normalized query (Redis-cached) and runs a pgvector cosine-similarity query with an ILIKE keyword fallback to rank FAQ entries.

nodes.name: pickSemanticWinner
nodes.summary: Applies score-floor and margin rules to ranked semantic rows to decide whether one FAQ wins confidently enough to bypass the LLM.

nodes.name: isExactMatch
nodes.summary: Checks a normalized query against an FAQ question and all its stored variants for equality.

nodes.name: tryFaqFastLane
nodes.summary: Entry point for the FAQ lane: normalizes the message and tries exact then semantic matching, returning null on failure so the orchestrator falls through to the LLM.

nodes.name: financial-overview-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic financial-overview lane composing P&L, receivables, and payables summaries into Vietnamese KPI widgets with anomaly flags for the current Vietnam period.

nodes.name: buildFinancialOverviewResponse
nodes.summary: Shapes computed financial data into rounded VND strings, net-margin metrics, anomaly notes, and KPI widgets for the agent response.

nodes.name: runFinancialOverview
nodes.summary: Resolves the current Vietnam period, fetches P&L plus aging summaries in parallel, and builds the financial-overview agent response.

nodes.name: intent-router.ts
nodes.summary: Rule-based Vietnamese intent router that classifies agent messages into navigation, FAQ, summary, financial-overview, deterministic-report, lookup, or general LLM lanes using normalized keyword and page-alias matching.
nodes.languageNotes: All matching runs on diacritic-stripped Vietnamese normalization with weighted page-alias/keyword tables and regex extraction — no LLM call in the routing path.

nodes.name: wordContains
nodes.summary: Checks whole-word containment with a substring fallback for normalized multi-byte text.

nodes.name: findPageMatch
nodes.summary: Scores the cleaned query against page aliases, titles, and keywords to find the best SPA page match for navigation intents.

nodes.name: extractPageQuery
nodes.summary: Strips leading navigation verbs (mo, xem, cho toi...) from a normalized query to isolate the page-search phrase.

nodes.name: routeIntent
nodes.summary: Main router: normalizes the message and dispatches to nav, FAQ, summary, financial-overview, report, lookup, or general lanes based on keyword and page matching.

nodes.name: isSummaryIntent
nodes.summary: Detects dashboard-summary phrases (tong quan, tinh hinh...) in the normalized Vietnamese query.

nodes.name: extractSimpleReportIntent
nodes.summary: Extracts a simple financial report request (period plus receivables/payables/profit focus) from the normalized query, deliberately rejecting analytical questions.

nodes.name: extractLookupQuery
nodes.summary: Extracts an entity-lookup query from 'cho toi/xem ...' phrasing when no other lane matched.

nodes.name: knowledge-ingest.ts
nodes.summary: Knowledge-base ingestion pipeline: chunks CONTEXT.md and ADR markdown by heading, embeds chunks with the embedding service, and upserts them into the knowledgeChunks pgvector table with content-hash versioning.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown chunking is heading-driven (h1-h4) with paragraph splitting for oversized sections; MD5 content hashes make re-ingestion idempotent.

nodes.name: chunkMarkdown
nodes.summary: Splits a markdown document into chunks at heading boundaries, further dividing oversized sections by paragraph.

nodes.name: flushChunk
nodes.summary: Emits one accumulated chunk, splitting it further when it exceeds the max size and deriving a heading from the first line when absent.

nodes.name: ingestChunks
nodes.summary: Embeds chunks in one batch, deletes stale rows for the same source, and inserts fresh knowledgeChunks rows with vector literals and content hashes.

nodes.name: readContextMd
nodes.summary: Reads and chunks the repo's CONTEXT.md knowledge source when present.

nodes.name: readAdrs
nodes.summary: Reads every ADR markdown file under the docs/adr directory and chunks each for ingestion.

nodes.name: ingestAll
nodes.summary: Runs the full ingestion pass over CONTEXT.md plus ADRs and reports counts and errors.

nodes.name: knowledge-retrieval.ts
nodes.summary: Semantic knowledge retrieval over ingested chunks: Redis-cached query embedding plus pgvector cosine search returning cited snippets to ground the agent's RAG answers.

nodes.name: chunkToCitation
nodes.summary: Converts a knowledge chunk row into a citation object with title, doc id, and snippet.

nodes.name: retrieveKnowledge
nodes.summary: Embeds the query (cached), runs a pgvector top-K cosine-similarity query, and maps rows to citations for grounding agent answers.

nodes.name: lookup-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Entity-lookup lane for the agent: runs semantic search across registry entities via semantic-data.service and formats results into Vietnamese rows with per-entity deep-link actions.

nodes.name: runLookup
nodes.summary: Executes a semantic entity search for the query and formats the grouped results into a timed lookup response.

nodes.name: formatLookupResponse
nodes.summary: Groups search results by entity, renders Vietnamese headers with row details, and appends navigation actions.

nodes.name: formatRowDetail
nodes.summary: Renders one result row's key fields as a compact detail string for the lookup response.

nodes.name: buildLookupActions
nodes.summary: Builds deduplicated navigate-to-detail actions from lookup results so the user can jump to the found records.

nodes.name: orchestrator.ts
nodes.summary: Core agent orchestrator: runs the MiniMax tool-calling loop with role-filtered tools, streams sanitized text deltas, executes readonly tools concurrently, sanitizes structured JSON responses and directives, and persists per-lane conversation turns.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a bounded agentic loop (selectTools → callMiniMaxStream → execute tools → produceFinalAnswer) with Vietnamese-language system prompts, a readonly-tool concurrency cache, and multi-layer output sanitizers that strip internal contract leaks before SSE emission.

nodes.name: toolsToMiniMax
nodes.summary: Converts internal AgentToolDef definitions into MiniMax function-tool descriptors with zod-derived JSON schemas.

nodes.name: directiveAckText
nodes.summary: Builds the Vietnamese acknowledgement text shown when the UI confirms an agent directive.

nodes.name: synthesizeNavigateFromProse
nodes.summary: Extracts an SPA route reference from free-text model output and synthesizes a navigate directive with numeric-only params.

nodes.name: synthesizeTextActionsFromProse
nodes.summary: Wraps prose navigation extraction to produce UI action directives from plain-text answers.

nodes.name: runAgent
nodes.summary: Main agent loop: selects role-appropriate tools, streams MiniMax responses through a safe-text delta filter, executes tool calls (readonly ones concurrently with caching), handles directives with UI acks, and produces the final sanitized answer with token attribution.

nodes.name: produceFinalAnswer
nodes.summary: Forces a final natural-language answer from the model when the tool loop ends without one, streaming it through the sanitizer and salvaging text from malformed JSON when needed.

nodes.name: parseLatestAssistantResponse
nodes.summary: Finds and returns the most recent assistant message content from the conversation stack.

nodes.name: parseAgentResponseContent
nodes.summary: Parses raw model content into structured agent response objects, tolerating surrounding prose and fenced JSON.

nodes.name: tryParseJson
nodes.summary: Attempts JSON.parse on trimmed text, returning null on failure instead of throwing.

nodes.name: preserveDetailedTerminalText
nodes.summary: Keeps a richer terminal text answer over a thinner summary when the candidate is substantially more detailed.

nodes.name: salvageText
nodes.summary: Recovers human-readable text from malformed model JSON by stripping markup and internal contract fragments.

nodes.name: isInternalContractLeak
nodes.summary: Detects internal schema/tool/directive vocabulary leaking into user-facing text so it can be filtered.

nodes.name: collectKnowledgeCitations
nodes.summary: Walks tool-result data structures to gather knowledge-base citations for grounding the answer.

nodes.name: sanitizeAgentJson
nodes.summary: Normalizes and validates raw model JSON into the agent's structured response contract — cards, widgets, directives, and tables — repairing common malformations before emission.

nodes.name: sanitizeDirective
nodes.summary: Validates and coerces a raw directive object into the known directive schema.

nodes.name: coerceNumeric
nodes.summary: Coerces model-provided values that should be numeric into finite numbers, defaulting on failure.

nodes.name: normalizeTableWidget
nodes.summary: Normalizes a model-emitted table widget into well-formed columns and rows for rendering.

nodes.name: extractFirstJsonObjectWithRemainder
nodes.summary: Extracts the first balanced JSON object from mixed prose-plus-JSON text along with the remainder string.

nodes.name: trimToolHistory
nodes.summary: Trims old tool-call/result message pairs from the conversation to keep the MiniMax context within budget while preserving recent turns.

nodes.name: persistTurn
nodes.summary: Persists one agent turn (user message, assistant response, tool trace, token usage) into the agentConversations/agentMessages tables.

nodes.name: recordFaqTurn
nodes.summary: Persists an FAQ-lane turn with its matched entry and latency for analytics.

nodes.name: recordNavTurn
nodes.summary: Persists a navigation-lane turn recording the matched route and query.

nodes.name: recordSummaryTurn
nodes.summary: Persists a summary-lane turn for the dashboard overview response.

nodes.name: recordLookupTurn
nodes.summary: Persists a lookup-lane turn with the query and returned entity results.

nodes.name: recordAbortedTurn
nodes.summary: Persists an aborted agent turn so cancelled conversations remain auditable.

nodes.name: routeMatcher.ts
nodes.summary: SPA route matching utilities: converts frontend path patterns into regexes, matches route keys from paths, and compares routes with numeric-only params for the agent's navigation directives.

nodes.name: matchRoute
nodes.summary: Matches a concrete SPA path against the registered route patterns and returns the route key with parsed params.

nodes.name: sameRoute
nodes.summary: Checks whether two route matches refer to the same route key and params, treating numeric params loosely.

nodes.name: hasOnlyNumericParams
nodes.summary: Returns true when every param in a route match is numeric, gating synthesized navigation directives.

nodes.name: semantic-data.service.ts
nodes.summary: Semantic data layer for the agent: a registry of queryable entities (trips, customers, trucks...) with dynamic Drizzle select/where builders powering natural-language search, list, detail, aggregate, and timeline tools.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a declarative SEMANTIC_ENTITIES registry (fields, aliases, searchable columns) compiled into parameterized Drizzle SQL — the LLM's data.* tools map onto these generic query primitives instead of hand-written endpoints.

nodes.name: listSemanticEntities
nodes.summary: Returns the keys of all registered semantic entities.

nodes.name: getSemanticEntityMeta
nodes.summary: Looks up the metadata definition for one semantic entity.

nodes.name: entityFieldNames
nodes.summary: Returns the selectable field names exposed for an entity.

nodes.name: semanticSearch
nodes.summary: Runs a cross-entity ILIKE keyword search over searchable fields and returns grouped matches for the lookup lane.

nodes.name: semanticList
nodes.summary: Lists rows of one entity filtered by the structured query with clamped pagination.

nodes.name: semanticDetail
nodes.summary: Fetches a single entity row by id.

nodes.name: semanticAggregate
nodes.summary: Computes grouped aggregates (count/sum/avg) over an entity according to the query's group-by and metric fields.

nodes.name: semanticTimeline
nodes.summary: Buckets entity rows by a date field into a timeline series for trend questions.

nodes.name: buildSelect
nodes.summary: Builds a Drizzle select projection from an entity definition and requested field list.

nodes.name: buildWhere
nodes.summary: Compiles the structured query filters into a Drizzle where clause with typed per-field comparators.

nodes.name: normalizeRow
nodes.summary: Serializes one database row into JSON-safe values (dates to ISO strings) for LLM consumption.

nodes.name: stream-sanitizer.ts
nodes.summary: Streaming text sanitizer that buffers LLM deltas until it can prove the emission is safe prose — suppressing JSON, internal contract leaks, and reasoning artifacts before they reach the SSE stream.

nodes.name: createSafeTextDeltaFilter
nodes.summary: Wraps an emit callback with a stateful filter that probes buffered text before releasing deltas, blocking structured/internal output from leaking to the user.

nodes.name: summary-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Dashboard-summary lane for the agent: composes role-filtered dashboard stats and registry metrics into KPI widgets, anomaly lists, and quick-action chips without an LLM call.

nodes.name: pathToRouteKey
nodes.summary: Maps a frontend metric path to the SPA route key that shows the underlying data.

nodes.name: buildActionChips
nodes.summary: Builds clickable action chips from summary items, each linking to a relevant page.

nodes.name: buildKpiWidget
nodes.summary: Shapes dashboard stats into a kpi_grid widget with VND-formatted values and metric provenance.

nodes.name: buildAnomalyWidget
nodes.summary: Builds an anomaly-list widget from congestion and yard-expiry alert counts.

nodes.name: runSummary
nodes.summary: Loads role-scoped dashboard stats and metrics, then composes the summary-lane response with KPI, anomaly, and action widgets.

nodes.name: system-prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the agent's Vietnamese system prompt from role context, the currently selected tools, and the user message, embedding the structured-response contract hint.

nodes.name: buildSystemPromptSections
nodes.summary: Assembles the prompt's sections: role identity, tool catalog descriptions, response-format contract, and current period context.

nodes.name: buildSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Joins the prompt sections into the final system message handed to MiniMax for a turn.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts
nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry span helpers for the agent: wraps sync and async operations in child spans or root spans with attributes, and exposes the active trace id for correlation.

nodes.name: withSpan
nodes.summary: Runs a function inside a child OTel span, recording exceptions and returning the result unchanged.

nodes.name: withRootSpan
nodes.summary: Runs a function inside a new root span for top-level agent operations that should start a fresh trace.

nodes.name: activeTraceId
nodes.summary: Returns the current span's trace id for embedding in responses and logs.

nodes.name: text.ts
nodes.summary: Vietnamese text normalization helper that strips diacritics, converts đ/Đ, lowercases, and collapses whitespace for consistent intent matching.

nodes.name: normalizeText
nodes.summary: Normalizes Vietnamese text to a diacritic-free lowercase form used by the intent router and FAQ matcher.

nodes.name: token-attribution.ts
nodes.summary: Estimates per-component token usage (system prompt, tools catalog, messages, tool results) for each agent turn and formats the attribution line logged for cost tracking.

nodes.name: estimateTokensByComponent
nodes.summary: Approximates token counts per conversation component using character-based estimation so each agent run can attribute cost to system prompt, tools, and history.

nodes.name: formatAttribution
nodes.summary: Renders a token attribution estimate as a compact human-readable log line.

nodes.name: tool-result-compact.ts
nodes.summary: Tool-result compaction: shrinks oversized tool payloads for the LLM context by dropping empty fields, capping rows with truncation markers, and JSON-cutting at safe string/container boundaries so partial output stays parseable.
nodes.languageNotes: cutAtSafeBoundary implements a mini JSON scanner that finds a truncation point outside string literals and re-closes open containers — truncated payloads remain syntactically valid JSON.

nodes.name: compactToolResult
nodes.summary: Entry point that compacts a tool result payload by shaping arrays and shrinking over-budget payloads before they enter the model context.

nodes.name: shrinkArrayPayload
nodes.summary: Shrinks an array payload to fit a character budget, dropping rows first and hard-cutting JSON as a last resort.

nodes.name: cutAtSafeBoundary
nodes.summary: Cuts a JSON string at the largest safe boundary before the budget, avoiding mid-string and mid-escape cuts and re-closing open containers so the result still parses.

nodes.name: scanJson
nodes.summary: Walks JSON text tracking string/escape state and container depth, invoking a visitor at each position.

nodes.name: closeOpenContainers
nodes.summary: Appends the closing brackets/braces needed to balance containers left open by a truncation cut.

nodes.name: tool-selector.ts
nodes.summary: Per-message tool pruning: selects the subset of role-available tools relevant to the user's message, derives the iteration budget from selection size, and builds cache keys for readonly tool executions.
nodes.languageNotes: Narrowing the advertised tool list per message cuts prompt tokens and helps the model choose correctly; the iteration budget scales down as the selected tool count grows.

nodes.name: selectToolsForMessage
nodes.summary: Filters the full tool list to those whose names or prefixes match the normalized message, keeping the advertised catalog small per turn.

nodes.name: iterationBudgetFor
nodes.summary: Computes the maximum agentic loop iterations for a message based on how many tools were selected.

nodes.name: readonlyToolCacheKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable cache key from a readonly tool name and its JSON-normalized arguments for orchestrator result caching.

nodes.name: tool.registry.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregates all domain tool modules (advances, analyzers, approvals, audit, data, expenses, finance, fleet, knowledge, ledger, payables, receivables, reports, salary, trips, ui) into one registry and resolves the role-scoped tool set plus individual tool lookup.

nodes.name: getToolsForRole
nodes.summary: Returns every tool whose allowedRoles includes the given role, forming the role's advertised tool catalog.

nodes.name: findTool
nodes.summary: Looks up a single tool definition by name across the full registry.

nodes.name: tool.types.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tool type system: defines AgentToolDef, AgentContext, and ToolResult contracts, the ToolError/ToolForbiddenError error classes, and the defineReadTool factory that wraps ~40 read-only backend functions with zod arg parsing and defense-in-depth role checks.
nodes.languageNotes: defineReadTool is the uniform 10-line recipe for every data tool: zod params are the single validation gate and allowedRoles is re-checked inside execute even though the registry already filtered per role.

nodes.name: defineReadTool
nodes.summary: Factory that wraps a read service function into a readonly AgentToolDef: parses args with zod, re-checks the caller's role, executes, and attaches a display label.

nodes.name: ToolError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown inside agent tools carrying a machine-readable code (invalid_args, not_found, forbidden, internal) that the orchestrator surfaces to the LLM.

nodes.name: ToolForbiddenError
nodes.summary: ToolError subclass signalling the caller's role may not use the tool, with a Vietnamese user-facing message.

nodes.name: advances.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools for the advances domain: list advance requests, list settlements, and per-forwarder outstanding advance balances, all office-role read tools over advance.service.

nodes.name: analyzers.ts
nodes.summary: Insight-analyzer agent tools that compose multiple report sources (P&L month-over-month, receivables aging, fuel variance, expense anomalies) and return data pre-shaped for insight cards rather than raw reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Tool descriptions are long Vietnamese prompts instructing the LLM which widgets (kpi_grid, bar_chart, anomaly_list, table) to render — the card composition stays with the model, only the data shaping is deterministic.

nodes.name: approvals.ts
nodes.summary: Single agent tool exposing the calling user's scoped approval queue (expenses, advances, payments awaiting their sign-off) via approval-queue.service.

nodes.name: audit.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tool for querying the user-action audit log with category filter, search, and pagination, scoped to the impersonated viewer's identity.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools for the semantic data gateway: whitelisted read-only search, list, detail, aggregate, and timeline tools over business entities, with Vietnamese-diacritic-insensitive entity-name normalization and metric-provenance tagging.
nodes.languageNotes: Entity aliases are normalized by stripping Vietnamese diacritics (NFD + combining-mark removal, đ/Đ special-cased) so LLM-provided names like 'lốp' or 'Tires' resolve to canonical entities.

nodes.name: normalizeSemanticEntityInput
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw LLM entity input by stripping Vietnamese diacritics, separators, and casing, then validates it against the SEMANTIC_ENTITIES whitelist.

nodes.name: dataTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing data.search, data.list, data.detail, data.aggregate, and data.timeline over the semantic-data service, with metric-registry provenance on aggregate results.

nodes.name: expenses.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools for the company-expenses domain: list, detail, and renewal-reminder reads that wrap expense.service behind office-role gating.

nodes.name: expenseTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing expenses.list, expenses.detail, and renewal-reminder tools for office staff.

nodes.name: finance.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools for the finance domain backing the two flagship analyzers (P&L report and fuel-variance report), defaulting omitted month/year to the current Vietnam period.

nodes.name: financeTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing profit.report and fuel.variance tools that delegate to getPnlReport/getFuelVarianceReport with resolvePeriod defaults.

nodes.name: fleet.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools for the fleet, drivers, and catalog domain: bootstrap data, pricing, fuel config, effective fuel price, driver earnings, and penalties.

nodes.name: fleetTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing fleet.catalog, drivers.list, and related fleet/driver read tools over config and driver services.

nodes.name: knowledge.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tool exposing the knowledge-RAG retrieval pipeline (knowledge.search) so the ReAct loop can answer product-doc and domain-glossary questions with cited chunks.

nodes.name: knowledgeTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing knowledge.search, returning retrieved chunks with source metadata for citations.

nodes.name: ledger.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools exposing raw ledger primitives (entries and balance queries) that the LLM composes for ad-hoc financial questions.

nodes.name: ledgerTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing ledger.entries and ledger.balance over the LedgerService.

nodes.name: payables.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools for the suppliers-and-payables domain: supplier lists, supplier statements, and the payables aging summary over the VENDOR ledger entity.

nodes.name: payablesTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing suppliers.list, payables.summary, and supplier-statement tools.

nodes.name: period.ts
nodes.summary: Current-period resolution in the Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh business timezone so agent phrases like 'tháng này' or 'nay' resolve to the real current period rather than a model guess or server-TZ drift.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Intl.DateTimeFormat formatToParts in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh instead of bare new Date(), avoiding the UTC-container bug where the wall clock rolls back a day at night and picks the wrong month.

nodes.name: vnParts
nodes.summary: Extracts year/month/day parts from the current instant via Intl in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, independent of server timezone.

nodes.name: currentVnPeriod
nodes.summary: Returns the current Vietnam business period as month and year.

nodes.name: currentVnDay
nodes.summary: Returns the current Vietnam business day as year, month, and day parts.

nodes.name: todayIsoVn
nodes.summary: Formats the current Vietnam business day as a zero-padded ISO yyyy-mm-dd string.

nodes.name: resolvePeriod
nodes.summary: Resolves optional month/year tool arguments to a concrete period, falling back to the current Vietnam period when the LLM omits them.

nodes.name: receivables.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools for the customers-and-receivables (debt) domain: customer lists, customer statements, and the receivables aging list with inline role checks.

nodes.name: receivablesTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing customers.list, customers.statement, and receivables-aging tools over ledger, statement, and aging services.

nodes.name: reports.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic business-report agent tools used for money and business totals where naive SUMs would violate VAT, service-fee, ledger-balance, or salary-deduction domain rules; every result carries metric provenance.

nodes.name: attachProvenance
nodes.summary: Attaches MetricDef provenance tags to a report result so the InsightCard UI can render how each number was derived.

nodes.name: normalizeReportKeyInput
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw LLM report-key input (Vietnamese diacritic stripping, whitespace removal, lowercasing) and validates it against the report-key schema.

nodes.name: reportTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing report.run and related deterministic report tools over P&L, aging, statement, salary, and expense services.

nodes.name: salary.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tools for the salary-and-attendance domain: per-driver salary computation, all-driver payroll, and attendance summaries.

nodes.name: salaryTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing salary.compute, salary.all_drivers, and attendance-summary tools over the attendance service.

nodes.name: trips.ts
nodes.summary: Read-only agent tools over the trips domain: trip queries, trip expenses, containers, financial adjustments, and live-fleet GPS, each office-staff gated with an in-execute role re-check.

nodes.name: tripTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing trip list/detail/summary tools plus trip expenses, containers, adjustments, and live-fleet lookups.

nodes.name: ui.ts
nodes.summary: Navigation-directive agent tools: navigate/focus/open/prefill emit directives the frontend bridge applies (the backend cannot drive the SPA directly), while ui.search_pages is a read tool returning the route catalog.

nodes.name: buildDirectiveTool
nodes.summary: Factory that wraps a directive-producing callback into an agent tool definition with office-role gating and zod parameter parsing.

nodes.name: normalizeNavigateArgs
nodes.summary: Normalizes loose LLM navigate arguments — route keys, camelCased highlight params, and duration coercion — into a well-formed navigate directive payload.

nodes.name: uiTools
nodes.summary: Exported tool array exposing ui.navigate, ui.focus, ui.open, ui.prefill, and ui.search_pages over the page-search catalog.

nodes.name: aging.service.ts
nodes.summary: Receivables/payables aging service: FIFO ledger aging buckets, customer aging lists with cross-entity search (customers, containers, fee containers), payables summaries by vendor/carrier scope, Redis caching keyed by as-of cutoff, and historical report metadata with SHA-256 checksums.
nodes.languageNotes: Receivable balances come from the customer-receivable-authority snapshots, while payables use FIFO aging over raw ledger rows; every response embeds as-of metadata plus a payload checksum for historical reproducibility.

nodes.name: historicalReportMetadata
nodes.summary: Builds as-of metadata (Vietnam cutoff dates, definition version, SHA-256 payload checksum) attached to aging reports for historical reproducibility.

nodes.name: fetchLedgerGrouped
nodes.summary: Queries ledger rows with entity-type, txn-type, as-of, and search-id filters via Drizzle, grouping debit/credit entries per entity in memory.

nodes.name: computeAging
nodes.summary: Runs FIFO aging over grouped ledger entries via the shared computeFifoAging helper, optionally inverting debit/credit signs for payables.

nodes.name: computeEntityResults
nodes.summary: Turns FIFO-aged entity invoices into result rows with outstanding totals and day-based aging relative to the reference date.

nodes.name: getEntityResultsCached
nodes.summary: Cache-or-compute wrapper around fetchLedgerGrouped plus computeEntityResults, using Redis cache keys derived from scope, txn types, and the Vietnam as-of cutoff.

nodes.name: paginateAgingRows
nodes.summary: Applies page/pageSize clamping and slicing to aging rows, returning the page plus total count.

nodes.name: findCustomerIdsForAgingSearch
nodes.summary: Resolves a free-text search to customer IDs by matching customer names, trip container codes, and fee-container codes through joins.

nodes.name: getReceivablesSummary
nodes.summary: Builds the receivables aging summary from customer receivable-authority snapshots, bucketing outstanding balances by age range with historical as-of metadata.

nodes.name: getTopOverdueCustomer
nodes.summary: Finds the customer with the highest outstanding receivable balance and returns their name for dashboard highlighting.

nodes.name: getCustomerAgingList
nodes.summary: Produces the paginated customer aging list, joining customer names/contacts, linked-supplier payables, and aging buckets, with search filtering and as-of metadata.

nodes.name: getPayablesForScope
nodes.summary: Computes payables aging for one scope (vendor or carrier), enriching entity results with carrier or supplier names and contact details.

nodes.name: mergePayablesSummaries
nodes.summary: Merges multiple payables summaries into one sorted item list with combined totals, used when no single category filter applies.

nodes.name: getPayablesSummary
nodes.summary: Entry point for the payables summary: resolves the category filter (fuel, ancillary, commission, carrier, or all) to scopes, computes them in parallel, and merges results with as-of metadata.

nodes.name: embeddings.ts
nodes.summary: Embedding client for the agent's knowledge/RAG pipeline: batches texts against the configured embedding model with timeout-guarded fetch, resolves the API key from LLM settings, and formats vectors as pgvector literals.

nodes.name: resolveApiKey
nodes.summary: Resolves the embedding API key from live LLM settings with an environment fallback.

nodes.name: embedTexts
nodes.summary: Embeds a batch of texts (capped and chunked) via the embedding endpoint with an abort-controller timeout, returning float arrays in input order.

nodes.name: embedText
nodes.summary: Single-text convenience wrapper around embedTexts.

nodes.name: vecLiteral
nodes.summary: Formats a float vector as a fixed-precision pgvector string literal for SQL inserts.

nodes.name: failover.ts
nodes.summary: Provider failover helpers: wrap buffered and streaming LLM calls so that retriable provider error codes transparently retry on the inactive provider.

nodes.name: callWithFailover
nodes.summary: Runs a buffered provider call and, on failover-eligible errors, warns and retries via the inactive provider's call function.

nodes.name: callStreamWithFailover
nodes.summary: Streaming variant of the failover wrapper: replays the stream through the inactive provider when the primary stream fails with a retriable code.

nodes.name: minimax.client.ts

nodes.name: MiniMaxError
nodes.summary: Typed error carrying an HTTP-like status code so the failover layer can classify retriable provider failures.

nodes.name: stripThink
nodes.summary: Removes reasoning blocks and leaked model-internal tool-call markup from completion content, handling both closed and truncated/unclosed tags.

nodes.name: createMiniMaxProvider
nodes.summary: Builds an LlmProvider instance whose complete/streamComplete run through the OpenAI-compatible runner with MiniMax base URL, key, model, and timeout.

nodes.name: callMiniMax

nodes.name: callMiniMaxStream
nodes.summary: Backward-compatible streaming shim delegating to the active provider's streamComplete.

nodes.name: models.ts

nodes.name: openai-runner.ts

nodes.languageNotes: parseSSEStream accumulates tool_call argument fragments by index across chunk boundaries and orders them at finalize — the non-trivial part of streaming function-calling over SSE without the OpenAI SDK.

nodes.name: runOpenAiCompletion
nodes.summary: Executes one buffered OpenAI-compatible completion: builds the request, honors timeout and parent abort signals, records a telemetry span, and normalizes the response content and tool calls.

nodes.name: runOpenAiStreamingCompletion
nodes.summary: Streaming variant: pipes content deltas to onText as they arrive, parses the SSE body for tool-call accumulation, and resolves with the same buffered result shape.

nodes.name: parseSSEStream
nodes.summary: Reads a fetch body stream, splits it into SSE events, invokes onText per content delta, and reassembles indexed tool-call fragments into complete calls at stream end.

nodes.name: parseOneSseEvent
nodes.summary: Parses a single raw SSE event into its data payload, joining multi-line data fields and JSON-parsing the result.

nodes.name: openrouter.client.ts
nodes.summary: OpenRouter provider adapter: builds an LlmProvider whose complete/streamComplete delegate to the shared OpenAI runner with OpenRouter base URL, model, and timeout.

nodes.name: createOpenRouterProvider
nodes.summary: Factory producing the OpenRouter LlmProvider, wiring buffered and streaming completions through the shared OpenAI-compatible runner.

nodes.name: provider-registry.ts

nodes.name: getActiveProvider

nodes.name: invalidateActiveProvider

nodes.name: metric-registry.ts
nodes.summary: Semantic metric registry: a large declarative map of business-metric definitions (single source of truth for every business number) plus lookup helpers by id and by entity/field for the agent's data and report tools.

nodes.summary: Looks up a MetricDef by its stable identifier.

nodes.name: getAllMetrics
nodes.summary: Returns every registered metric definition.

nodes.name: getMetricIds
nodes.summary: Returns all registered metric identifiers.

nodes.name: getMetricByEntityField

nodes.name: pnl.service.ts
nodes.summary: Profit-and-loss reporting service: builds the monthly P&L report (revenue from financial postings, penalties, maintenance, fleet fixed-cost allocation by revenue share, truck depreciation from versioned financial profiles) and the fuel-variance report comparing recorded fuel against leg norms and confirmed evidence — all in BigInt whole-money arithmetic with Redis caching.
nodes.languageNotes: All money math runs through BigInt whole-integer helpers (parseWholeMoney, divideAndRound) with a largest-remainder allocation for revenue-share splits, avoiding floating-point drift in VND amounts; results embed a SHA-256 definition-version checksum.

nodes.name: computeMonthlyDepreciationForReportMonth
nodes.summary: Computes a truck's monthly straight-line depreciation for the report month from its versioned financial-profile history, prorating for partial in-service months and the useful-life cap.

nodes.name: allocateIntegerAmountByRevenue
nodes.summary: Allocates a whole-integer amount across trips proportionally to revenue using largest-remainder rounding so the parts sum exactly to the total.

nodes.name: recordedTripRevenue
nodes.summary: Returns a trip's recorded revenue as a safe number, derived from whole-money ex-VAT/VAT components.

nodes.name: getPnlReport
nodes.summary: Builds the full monthly P&L report: month-scoped trips from active financial postings, penalties, maintenance expenses by component and truck, fleet fixed-cost and depreciation allocation by revenue share, route and truck breakdowns, and checksummed report metadata — behind a Redis cache.

nodes.name: getFuelVarianceReport
nodes.summary: Builds the monthly fuel-variance report comparing recorded fuel liters against leg-norm calculations (flat-rate, fixed-allowance, or norm-plus-supplement modes), joined with the latest confirmed fuel-evidence reviews per trip.

nodes.name: agent-semantic-data.test.ts

Catches silent column-vanish regressions where buildSelect/buildWhere skip a renamed field without erroring.

nodes.name: agent-strip-think.test.ts

nodes.name: agent-system-prompt.test.ts

nodes.name: agent-tool-compact.test.ts

nodes.name: agent-tool-selector.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests intent-scoped tool selection: greetings advertise no tools and get a one-iteration budget, and the read-only tool cache key is insensitive to object argument key order so identical calls never execute twice.

nodes.name: aging-pagination.test.ts

nodes.name: deterministic-report-lane.test.ts

nodes.name: faq-fast-lane.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the FAQ fast lane: diacritic-insensitive exact match (Stage 1) and the semantic winner gate (Stage 4) covering SCORE_FLOOR and MARGIN thresholds, thin-margin abstention, boundary values, empty candidate sets, and a lock on the tuned threshold constants.

nodes.name: final-schema-repro.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression suite for the P0.5 final_schema hotfix in the orchestrator: sanitizes unknown widget types (metric/chart/list coercion), unwraps wrapped response objects, coerces table cells and string numerics, maps type aliases, and handles the P1 callout field-name regression (content vs text) — all validated through sanitizeAgentJson plus agentResponseSchema.
nodes.languageNotes: Each hotfix category is a separate describe block exercising a shared validate() helper that composes sanitizeAgentJson with agentResponseSchema.safeParse.

nodes.name: financial-overview-lane.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests buildFinancialOverviewResponse: schema-valid profitable card with canonical navigation, loss reported without sign reversal, zero-revenue handled without invalid percentages, and month-to-date title annotation driven by a defensively ranged asOfDay.

nodes.name: fleet-fixed-cost-allocation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the fleet fixed-cost allocation helpers in the P&L service: service origin stays immutable across truck financial profile versions, depreciation is capped at lifetime base and never restarts, integer whole-money amounts allocate deterministically by revenue share, and unsafe recorded-revenue values are rejected at the public number boundary.
nodes.languageNotes: Allocation assertions use BigInt whole-money literals (14_000n), matching the VND integer-precision convention of the finance layer.

nodes.name: intent-router.test.ts
nodes.summary: P1 intent-router suite: Lane 0 navigation positives and negatives, deterministic financial-overview detection, edge cases (empty message, nav verb without target, unknown page, English 'go to'), and an aggregate misroute-rate gate asserting ≤10% across all 35 golden cases.

nodes.name: knowledge-lane.test.ts
nodes.summary: P2 knowledge-lane tests: chunkMarkdown heading-based splitting with sourceType inference and paragraph-boundary splits for oversized chunks, the citation schema and chunkToCitation mapping (ADR deep-links), the AgentResponse citations field's backward compatibility, and the knowledge.search tool output shape.

nodes.name: lookup-lane.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests Lane 2 lookup intent detection: positive and negative Vietnamese lookup phrases route correctly, and the constructed response shape (text with lookup results, plus a not-found path) validates against agentResponseSchema.

nodes.name: metric-registry.test.ts
nodes.summary: P4 metric-registry contract tests: at least 15 metrics with required fields and unique ids, key metrics present, drift notes documented (VAT drift on revenue, per-trip vs monthly driver salary), entity-field resolution via getMetricByEntityField, provenance schema categories, and provenance-tagged KPI widget validation.

nodes.name: p03-stream-shape.test.ts
nodes.summary: Documents and verifies the P0.3 stream-shape spike: the stripThink backstop contract for think/tool_call markup in accumulated content, and the streaming delta contract — onText receives raw pre-cleanContent deltas while the orchestrator's probe-then-commit buffers the first 3 chars to mitigate JSON leaks.
nodes.languageNotes: The header comment records the 2026-07-13 spike result (reasoning_split: true keeps think tokens out of content deltas) making the test double as design documentation.

nodes.name: p04-model-tier-spike.test.ts
nodes.summary: Documents the P0.4 model-tier spike: MODEL_FAST is a MiniMax highspeed model with an OpenRouter flash alternate, AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS capped at 4 with a 60s timeout, measured production baseline showing all MiniMax models average over 10s LLM time, DeepSeek V4 Flash recommended as the fast tier, and a tool-selection probe set gated at under 15% fallback rate.

nodes.name: payables-summary-merge.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests mergePayablesSummaries in the aging service: the all-category merged result includes both vendor and outsourced-carrier payables summaries.

nodes.name: pnl-fleet-allocation-persisted.test.ts

nodes.languageNotes: Uses a randomized Date.now-based fixture suffix and an after() hook with inArray deletes; invalidates report caches via cacheInvalidatePattern before assertions.

nodes.name: pnl-invariant.test.ts
nodes.summary: A8/GAP-8b P&L invariant regression against the dev database with cache bypassed: sum of vehicle-bucket profit equals adjustedGrossProfit, penalty income enters netProfit exactly once through the documented formula, ancillary service/ocean-fee margin stays out of transport P&L, external-carrier bucket carries margin only, and commission-bearing reports use recorded revenue. Tolerance scales with trip count to absorb per-trip VAT rounding.
nodes.languageNotes: Tolerance is computed as a function of trip count so aggregate VAT-rounding drift (~1 VND per rated trip) never masks a real double-count, which would be off by thousands.

nodes.name: routeMatcher.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests route matching and navigation synthesis: matchRoute resolves parametric paths (stripping query/hash) to routeKey plus params, sameRoute distinguishes different params on the same routeKey, and the orchestrator's synthesizeNavigateFromProse/synthesizeTextActionsFromProse build navigate directives with default highlights, suppress same-page navigation, and reject non-numeric parametric paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Flat top-level test() blocks (no describe wrapper) — direct node:test style with Vietnamese prose fixtures.

nodes.name: scheduler.test.ts

nodes.name: summary-lane.test.ts

nodes.name: billing-document-security.test.ts
nodes.summary: Security tests for the billing document write contract: only immutable TRIP source identities with full financial-posting provenance (version + checksum) are accepted, and browser-authored money, exclusions, overrides, or ad-hoc rows are rejected.

nodes.name: cus-shipment-workspace.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the CUS (customer-service) shipment workspace Zod schemas covering suffix-search validation, list-item shape with explicit unavailable custody state, and container-line update rules.

nodes.name: cus-shipment-workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Defines 25 strict Zod schemas for the customer-service shipment workspace: query filters with 4-5 char Bill/Book suffix search, finance and operational summaries, document custody, accounting confirmation, locks and reopen flows, debit notes, container lines, recovery records, and flat-row responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Money fields are validated as regex'd strings ('^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$') to mirror PG numeric serialization rather than coercing to numbers, preserving exact decimal fidelity.

nodes.name: customerSchema.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests customerSchema and customerUpdateSchema debit-note-mode rules: WEEKLY accepted on new writes, legacy PER_BATCH only tolerated on unchanged-row updates, unknown modes rejected, plus distinct name/shortName and blank-shortName validation.

nodes.name: fuelActualUnitPrice.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression guard pinning the lossless VND round-trip for manually entered fuel unit prices (the reported '23,530 became 23,528' drift), asserting exact preservation through Zod parse for awkward boundary values in both number and string input forms.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central Zod validation library (107 exports) for the whole platform: numeric transform helpers for PG numeric columns, trip/payment/penalty/billing-document schemas, user/auth/customer schemas, fleet (truck/trailer/tire) schemas, fuel and pricing config, shipment lifecycle and dispatch schemas, advance requests, driver progress, and Bach Khoa GPS response parsing; also re-exports the agent, financial-reporting-policy, LLM/OCR settings, and geotag schema modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom ctx.addIssue transforms (numericMoney, fixedScaleDecimal) coerce union number|string input while emitting Vietnamese error messages; superRefine callbacks enforce cross-field invariants like Bill-vs-Booking exclusivity and duplicate carrier allocations.

nodes.name: fixedScaleDecimal
nodes.summary: Builds a Zod schema factory that accepts number-or-string input and validates it as a fixed-scale decimal with a capped integer-digit count, padding the fraction part to the exact scale.

nodes.name: validateShipmentDocumentReferences
nodes.summary: Super-refine validator enforcing shipment document reference rules: whitespace-only refs are rejected, and a shipment cannot carry both a Bill (blNumber) and a Booking (bookingRef) reference.

nodes.name: parseBachKhoaResponse
nodes.summary: Parses a raw Bach Khoa GPS API response through bachKhoaResponseSchema and filters out entries with blank number plates.

nodes.name: shipment-schema.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests create/update shipment schemas: canonical calendar-date acceptance, rejection of malformed/impossible dates, nullable delivery dates, the consolidation flag, recipient-specific driver notes, and Bill-plus-Booking mutual exclusion.

nodes.name: supplier-schema.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests supplierSchema category handling: case-insensitive normalization and trimming of canonical supplier types, and rejection of unknown or non-string category values.

nodes.name: updateTripFiguresSchema.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests trip figures update schemas: fuel supplement liters require a Vietnamese reason when positive, null external-carrier fields are accepted, bulk updates tolerate per-row malformed figures for row-level handling, and empty batches are rejected.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central TypeScript type library for the shared package: interfaces for users, drivers, customers, trips, shipments, containers, billing documents, advances, expenses, fleet, tires, and config rows that form the wire contract between the Express backend and React frontend, with numeric columns typed as strings to mirror PG serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure declaration module (one tiny function); PG numeric(15,0) columns are typed string|null because Drizzle serializes them as strings, a deliberate cross-stack convention.

nodes.name: parseThreshold
nodes.summary: Parses a raw threshold value to a finite number, falling back to the supplied default when parsing fails.

nodes.name: gps.service.ts
nodes.summary: Live fleet tracking service that joins GPS provider vehicle readings with active trips, drivers, customers, and route polylines, derives stale/lost-signal status, and persists last-known positions to vehicle_last_positions — served through getLiveFleet with Redis caching.
nodes.languageNotes: Persists last-known positions via Drizzle insert().onConflictDoUpdate upserts fired asynchronously with .catch() so snapshot writes never block the fleet response.

nodes.name: fetchLegsWithRoutes
nodes.summary: Fetches trip legs with origin/destination places and attaches matching route polylines (bidirectional match) from route_polylines for fleet map rendering.

nodes.name: toPositionRow
nodes.summary: Maps a composed live-fleet vehicle entry into a vehicle_last_positions upsert row.

nodes.name: loadActiveTrips
nodes.summary: Loads in-progress trips joined with trucks, drivers, customers, and routes to give the live fleet view its trip context.

nodes.name: loadLastKnownPositions
nodes.summary: Loads the most recently persisted position per truck from vehicle_last_positions for the given truck IDs.

nodes.name: persistLastPositions
nodes.summary: Upserts composed fleet positions into vehicle_last_positions, keeping a durable last-known snapshot per truck.

nodes.name: loadRecentTripsByTruck
nodes.summary: Loads each truck's most recent non-canceled trip to provide popup context for trucks without an active assignment.

nodes.name: loadLastKnownAll
nodes.summary: Builds last-known positions for all trucks, falling back to the newest captured GPS track polyline (decoded to its final point) when no live position row exists.

nodes.name: composeFleet
nodes.summary: Pure composition step that matches normalized provider vehicles to trucks by normalized license plate, derives stale/lost-signal status, attaches trip legs and route polylines, and returns the vehicle list plus rows queued for persistence.

nodes.name: getLiveFleet
nodes.summary: Main entry point: reads app settings, loads active trips, fetches live vehicles via the selected GPS provider (with Redis cache and date revival), composes the fleet, then backfills uncovered trucks from persisted positions and recent trips before asynchronously persisting snapshots.

nodes.name: parse.ts
nodes.summary: Pure GPS parsing utilities shared by all providers and the fleet service: license-plate normalization, Bách Khoa and ASP.NET date parsing (Vietnam UTC+7 wall-clock), JSON date revival, staleness checks, and vehicle status derivation.
nodes.languageNotes: Provider timestamps arrive as Vietnam local time without timezone markers, so parsers construct UTC dates from a fixed +7 offset rather than trusting the host timezone.

nodes.name: normalizePlate
nodes.summary: Normalizes Vietnamese license plates by uppercasing and stripping dash/dot/space separators so provider plates match DB plates.

nodes.name: parseBachKhoaDate
nodes.summary: Parses the public API's 'HH:mm:ss - dd/MM/yyyy' timestamps as Vietnam local time (UTC+7) into true UTC Dates; returns null for malformed input.

nodes.name: parseAspDate
nodes.summary: Parses ASP.NET /Date(epoch)/ values, treating the epoch as Vietnam wall-clock and converting it to true UTC.

nodes.name: reviveDate
nodes.summary: Revives JSON-round-tripped date values (ISO strings) back into Date objects, returning null for garbage input — fixes a crash where staleness checks received a string.

nodes.name: isStale
nodes.summary: Returns true when a vehicle's last fix is older than the staleness threshold (default 10 minutes) or the date is null.

nodes.name: deriveStatus
nodes.summary: Derives the display status (offline / moving / stopped) from staleness, the lost-signal flag, and speed.

nodes.name: apiProvider.ts
nodes.summary: GPS provider adapter for the Bách Khoa public API: maps raw vehicle responses into the normalized shape with ignition and lost-signal detection, honoring per-deployment GPS settings and an abort-controller timeout.

nodes.name: mapApiVehicle
nodes.summary: Maps a raw public-API vehicle record into the provider-neutral NormalizedGpsVehicle shape, parsing timestamps and detecting ignition and lost-signal states.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: GPS provider selector that resolves the active source from the BACH_KHOA_PROVIDER config (api / portal / auto), where auto prefers the public API and falls back to the portal with a 5-minute negative cache to avoid repeating dead API calls.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level mutable state (apiNegativeUntil) implements the negative cache; invalidateGpsProvider() resets it after credential changes.

nodes.name: invalidateGpsProvider
nodes.summary: Resets the API negative-backoff timer so the next poll retries the public API after an admin changes GPS credentials.

nodes.name: getGpsProvider
nodes.summary: Returns the active GpsProvider implementation based on the BACH_KHOA_PROVIDER config value, defaulting to the auto-fallback provider.

nodes.name: portalProvider.ts
nodes.summary: GPS provider adapter that fetches vehicles from the Bách Khoa web portal through the shared portal session client, validating each raw record with a Zod schema before mapping it to the normalized shape with portal-only telemetry.

nodes.name: mapPortalVehicle
nodes.summary: Maps a Zod-validated portal vehicle record into the normalized shape, including portal-only telemetry (fuel, extended details) and absolute image URLs.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the provider-neutral GPS contracts: NormalizedGpsVehicle (the common vehicle reading every source maps into) and the GpsProvider interface each source adapter implements.

nodes.name: reports.ts
nodes.summary: Bách Khoa portal report client that fetches HTML report pages (journeys, stops, overspeed, fuel, oil, activity, speed) via the portal session, scrapes them with regex-based table/entity parsing, and returns typed rows through the reportService facade.
nodes.languageNotes: The portal returns HTML tables rather than JSON, so every report parser runs regex row extraction plus HTML entity decoding, with Vietnamese header/footer rows filtered out of data sets.

nodes.name: fetchReport
nodes.summary: POSTs a report request to the portal for a car and date range, converting ISO dates to the portal's dd/MM/yyyy form and returning the raw HTML response.

nodes.name: resolveCarId
nodes.summary: Resolves a license plate to the portal CarID the report endpoints expect, by matching normalized plates against live portal vehicles.

nodes.name: getStopDetail
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses the portal stop-detail report into stop events with times, durations, coordinates, and addresses.

nodes.name: getTripSegments
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses the portal trip-segment report into per-segment start/end times, durations, and distances.

nodes.name: getJourney
nodes.summary: Fetches the portal journey report and extracts time/lat/lng/address track points, locating cells by pattern because empty cells shift column indices; downsamples to maxPoints.

nodes.name: getJourneyRange
nodes.summary: Aggregates daily journey reports across a multi-day range, deduplicating and sorting all track points by time.

nodes.name: getOverSpeed
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses the overspeed report into violation events with times, durations, and peak speeds.

nodes.name: getSummaryByCar
nodes.summary: Fetches the per-car summary report and extracts distance, movement/stop durations, and the route bounding box.

nodes.name: getOilManage
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses the fuel/oil management report into per-day fuel rows plus totals (consumption, refuel, deficit, average liters/100km).

nodes.name: getCarSpeed
nodes.summary: Fetches the speed report and extracts a time/samples series, downsampled to maxSamples.

nodes.name: getActivitySummary
nodes.summary: Fetches the activity summary report and extracts total running/stop time, distance, and the covered time range.

nodes.name: getFuelEvents
nodes.summary: Fetches the fuel-events report and extracts refuel/defuel events with times and volume deltas, filtering header rows.

nodes.name: getStopCar
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses the per-car stop report into stop records with times, durations, coordinates, and addresses.

nodes.name: route-capture.ts
nodes.summary: Pure GPS track geometry utilities: Google polyline encode/decode, haversine distance, point deduplication, bidirectional route resolution from captured polylines, Vietnam-timezone trip windowing, and leg slicing by origin/destination proximity.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Google encoded-polyline algorithm (1e5 precision, zigzag varint chunks) by hand with configurable precision for decode.

nodes.name: encodePolyline
nodes.summary: Encodes lat/lng points into a Google-style encoded polyline using zigzag delta varint chunks.

nodes.name: decodePolyline
nodes.summary: Decodes a Google-style encoded polyline back into [lat, lng] points at the given precision.

nodes.name: resolveRoute
nodes.summary: Resolves a captured route polyline for an origin/destination pair bidirectionally, reversing the polyline when only the opposite direction was captured.

nodes.name: dedupPoints
nodes.summary: Drops GPS track points within a radius (meters) of the last kept point to thin stationary clusters.

nodes.name: tripWindowBoundsMs
nodes.summary: Computes the time window for attributing GPS points to a trip: departure-day Vietnam midnight minus one hour through the completion instant (or end of completion day).

nodes.name: filterToWindow
nodes.summary: Filters timestamped GPS items to a trip window, keeping null-time items and passing everything through when bounds are degenerate.

nodes.name: sliceLegByPlaces
nodes.summary: Slices a GPS trail to a single leg by locating where the truck passed near the origin and destination coordinates within a tolerance.

nodes.name: route-lookup.ts
nodes.summary: Loads GPS-captured route polylines from route_polylines for a set of trip legs, matching origin/destination pairs bidirectionally so one captured direction serves both.

nodes.name: fetchRouteMap
nodes.summary: Queries route_polylines for normalized origin/destination pairs (both directions) and returns a pair-keyed map of polylines with distances.

nodes.name: maps.service.ts
nodes.summary: Maps service providing place autocomplete via Map4D, distance lookups from GPS-captured route polylines (Google Directions retired), and leg stop-coordinate resolution combining decoded polylines with Map4D geocoding.

nodes.name: getPlaceAutocomplete
nodes.summary: Returns up to eight Map4D place suggestions for an autocomplete query.

nodes.name: getDistance
nodes.summary: Resolves distance (km) and polyline for an origin/destination pair from captured GPS route polylines, matching bidirectionally; returns empty when neither direction was captured.

nodes.name: resolveLegCoords
nodes.summary: Resolves per-leg origin/destination coordinates for numbered map markers: first from decoded route polylines (free), then geocoding remaining unique place names via Map4D with Redis caching.

nodes.name: gps.service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the GPS fleet service covering plate normalization, Vietnam-timezone date parsing, staleness/status derivation, JSON date revival (a regression crash), shared response parsing, and composeFleet matching/persistence behavior.

nodes.name: vehicle
nodes.summary: Test factory that builds overridable NormalizedGpsVehicle fixtures for fleet-composition tests.

nodes.name: route-capture.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for route-capture geometry utilities: polyline encode/decode round-trips, bidirectional route resolution, coordinate-based leg slicing, point deduplication, and Vietnam-timezone trip-window filtering including an end-to-end trail-narrowing case.

nodes.name: fuelSurcharge.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for computeFuelSurcharge covering rate/amount rounding, input clamping, and fallback behavior for the fuel surcharge calculation.

nodes.name: fuelSurcharge.ts
nodes.summary: Computes fuel surcharge amounts for trips, applying rate/amount rules and rounding results via the shared round helpers so backend and frontend agree on VND figures.

nodes.name: round.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exhaustive unit tests for the round2dp and roundInt rounding helpers, including negative numbers, half-value cases, and floating-point edge inputs.

nodes.name: round.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the canonical financial rounding helpers round2dp and roundInt plus fuel-norm fallback constants used across all money and fuel-liter calculations in the platform.
nodes.languageNotes: Sign-aware rounding via Math.sign/Math.abs avoids parseFloat/toFixed floating-point drift; the same file doubles as home for fuel-norm fallback constants.

nodes.name: tripTotals.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive 517-line test suite for computeTripTotals covering AUTO vs FLAT_RATE fuel modes, fixed route allowances, per-leg norm flooring, VAT/commission handling, external-carrier margins, and backhaul toll dedup.

nodes.name: tripTotals.ts
nodes.summary: Core P&L engine of the platform: computes trip fuel liters (AUTO norm-based vs FLAT_RATE vs fixed route allowance), road allowance, net toll with backhaul deduction, ex-VAT freight, customer commission, and gross/external margins for OWN vs EXTERNAL carriers.
nodes.languageNotes: Integer-liter invariants: every fuel quantity is rounded per-leg before summing so the issued total matches the station handover; nullish coalescing treats 0 as a valid price.

nodes.name: computeFuelSurcharge
nodes.summary: Calculates a fuel surcharge from rate and amount inputs, delegating final rounding to roundInt/round2dp for consistent VND presentation.

nodes.name: round2dp
nodes.summary: Rounds a number to 2 decimal places using sign-aware math to avoid floating-point drift; the standard helper for non-VND currency figures.

nodes.name: roundInt
nodes.summary: Rounds to the nearest whole number with a non-negative clamp; used for fuel liters and VND amounts that must stay integral.

nodes.name: computeRoadAllowance
nodes.summary: Derives the driver road allowance from base rate, toll stations, additions/discounts, and return-cargo bonus, clamped at zero.

nodes.name: computeTripTotals
nodes.summary: Full trip P&L computation: resolves fuel liters by precedence (FLAT_RATE > fixed route allowance > per-leg norms), prices fuel with variance tracking, nets tolls against backhaul deduction, then branches OWN vs EXTERNAL carrier cost/margin models and returns the complete totals object.

nodes.name: useFocusDeepLink.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a FocusHarness test component to verify useFocusDeepLink reads focus query params, highlights the target element, and cleans the URL afterwards.

nodes.name: useFocusDeepLink.ts
nodes.summary: React hook implementing the ?focus=<target> deep-link convention: waits for the element to appear via MutationObserver, scrolls it into view, triggers the agent highlight effect, and strips the param from the URL once done.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses react-router's useSearchParams plus a MutationObserver and timeout fallback so late-mounting rows (paginated tables) still get focused.

nodes.name: agentHighlight.ts
nodes.summary: Drives the driver.js spotlight used to highlight page elements for guided tours and agent directives: resolves the target, scrolls it into view, manages a single active driver instance, and auto-dismisses after a duration.

nodes.name: tourTarget.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for resolveTourTarget covering id lookup, CSS-selector resolution, and cssEscape escaping of special characters.

nodes.name: tourTarget.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves tour/highlight target identifiers to DOM elements, first by CSS selector query and then by element id, with a safe CSS.escape shim for older browsers.

nodes.name: clearFocusSearchParams
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the given URLSearchParams with the focus-related params removed, used to clean the address bar after a deep link resolves.

nodes.name: useFocusDeepLink
nodes.summary: Hook that consumes ?focus=&duration= search params under a data-* attribute prefix, observes the DOM until the target mounts, then highlights it and clears the params; disconnects observer and timer on unmount.

nodes.name: highlightElement
nodes.summary: Spots a DOM element with driver.js: resolves the tour target, destroys any previous highlight, scrolls into view, and schedules auto-dismiss after durationMs.

nodes.name: resolveTourTarget
nodes.summary: Resolves a target id to a DOM element by CSS selector first, falling back to getElementById so both convention styles work.

nodes.name: cssEscape
nodes.summary: Escapes a value for safe use in CSS selectors, delegating to CSS.escape with a regex fallback.

nodes.name: DropdownMenu.tsx
nodes.summary: Design-system wrapper around Radix DropdownMenu re-exporting eight themed subcomponents (Content, Item, CheckboxItem, Separator, Label, etc.) styled with project CSS variables and the cn class helper.
nodes.languageNotes: forwardRef wrappers with displayName; all styling routes through cn() and var(--*) tokens so the vendored Radix primitives match the app theme.

nodes.name: Select.tsx
nodes.summary: Design-system wrapper around Radix Select re-exporting six themed subcomponents (Trigger, Content, Item, Group, Value) with z-index-aware popover positioning and lucide check/chevron indicators.
nodes.languageNotes: SelectContent sets z-[400] to sit above sticky headers/bottom-nav but below modals, and uses collisionPadding=80 to keep popper content on screen.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Defines cn(), the single class-name combiner used by every UI component to merge conditional Tailwind classes.

nodes.name: cn
nodes.summary: Flattens nested class-name inputs, drops falsy entries, and joins them with spaces.

nodes.name: DataTable.tsx
nodes.summary: Core design-system table component: renders column-driven desktop tables with sticky headers, skeleton loading rows, custom empty states, row click/row-styling hooks, a mobile card fallback via mobileRender, and optional integrated pagination.
nodes.languageNotes: Single component branches into desktop table vs mobile card markup inside one render tree; row CSS variables are injected via a cssVars() helper for per-row striping.

nodes.name: Pagination.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Pagination component to assert page-window construction, prev/next behavior, and item-range summary display.

nodes.name: Pagination.tsx
nodes.summary: Design-system pagination control with sibling-based page windowing, ellipsis gaps, item-range summary, and disabled state, memoized via useMemo for use under large tables.

nodes.name: DataTable
nodes.summary: Generic table renderer taking data, columns, pagination, and mobileRender props; builds loading skeletons, clickable styled rows with per-row CSS vars, desktop cells from accessor/render, and mobile cards when provided.

nodes.name: buildPageWindow
nodes.summary: Computes the visible page-button list with leading/trailing windows and ellipsis placeholders given current page, total pages, and sibling count.

nodes.name: Pagination
nodes.summary: Controlled pagination UI: prev/next buttons, windowed page numbers, and an optional item-count summary wired to the onChange handler.

nodes.name: hooks.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared test harness withQueryClient (QueryClientProvider wrapper) plus renderHook tests for useDebouncedValue and useTableQueryState covering debounce timing and page/search/filter state transitions.

nodes.name: useDebouncedValue.ts
nodes.summary: Small React hook returning a value that only updates after a configurable delay, used to keep keystroke-driven searches from hammering the API.

nodes.name: useTableQueryState.ts
nodes.summary: Standard table-state hook: manages page/pageSize/search/filters with debounced search, resets page on filter change, and runs a react-query useQuery against the provided paginated endpoint to expose rows, totalPages, and a reset callback.
nodes.languageNotes: Encapsulates the project's table-query contract (endpoint + params object) so every catalog/worksheet page shares identical pagination and filter-reset semantics.

nodes.name: useDebouncedValue
nodes.summary: Debounces a value by delayMs using useState/useEffect with timer cleanup on each change.

nodes.name: useTableQueryState
nodes.summary: Hosts the full query lifecycle for data tables: debounced search text, memoized params, useQuery fetch, page clamping against totalPages, and setSearch/setFilters/setPage/setPageSize callbacks that auto-reset paging.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel of the accounting feature, re-exporting AccountingWorkspaceRoot as the feature's single entry point.

nodes.name: AccountingWorkspacePage.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Page-level tests that render AccountingWorkspacePage via a renderPage helper to verify the accounting workspace mounts and shows its expected shell.

nodes.name: AccountingWorkspacePage.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin route page that delegates entirely to the accounting feature's AccountingWorkspaceRoot and imports the page-specific stylesheet.

nodes.name: AccountingWorkspacePage
nodes.summary: Default-exported page component rendering the accounting feature root; keeps the route layer decoupled from feature internals.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context allowlist for the backend image: starts from an ignore-all pattern and re-admits exactly the workspace manifests, shared sources, backend sources, and drizzle migrations the backend Dockerfile COPYs, excluding tests and spec files.
nodes.languageNotes: Inverted-deny pattern ('*' then targeted '!unignore' rules) keeps the root context usable for pnpm workspace linking while shrinking the transmitted build context.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Two-stage backend image: a node:22-alpine builder stage activates pnpm, installs workspace deps with cache mounts, and compiles shared+backend TypeScript; the production stage copies only built output, pruned node_modules, casbin policy files, drizzle migrations, and Vietnamese fonts, then serves on port 3090.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BuildKit cache mounts for pnpm store and tsc incremental builds, plus pnpm deploy-style injection of workspace packages into a prunable /prod tree.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Build stage on node:22-alpine: enables corepack/pnpm 10, fetches workspace dependencies with a shared pnpm store cache, then type-checks shared and backend packages and produces a pruned production node_modules tree.

nodes.name: production
nodes.summary: Runtime stage exposing port 3090: ships compiled backend dist, casbin model.conf/policy.csv, drizzle SQL migrations, BeVietnamPro fonts, an uploads directory, and launches node dist/index.js under NODE_ENV=production.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Two-stage frontend image: a node:22-alpine build stage installs pnpm workspace deps, compiles the shared TS package, and runs a cached Vite production build; an nginx:alpine stage then serves the static bundle with the project's nginx.conf on port 80.
nodes.languageNotes: BuildKit cache mounts for pnpm store, tsc, and Vite; the 8GB NODE_OPTIONS heap accommodates the large React bundle build.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Build stage on node:22-alpine: activates pnpm 10, installs workspace dependencies with shared pnpm store cache, builds the shared package with an incremental tsc cache, then produces the Vite dist bundle behind a Vite cache mount.

nodes.name: nginx
nodes.summary: Runtime stage on nginx:alpine exposing port 80: copies the built SPA bundle into the nginx html root and installs the project nginx.conf as the default site, running nginx in the foreground.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list that keeps dependency dirs, git/agent state, uploads, tests, coverage, docs, plans, and env files out of the backend/frontend production images so builds stay small and secret-free.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Mandatory working contract for every coding agent in the repo: trunk-based git on main only (no branches/worktrees/PRs), skill selection rules, progressive context loading via pnpm context, the closed-loop SDLC with QA gates and fix-loop rules, mandatory qa/ artifacts, and the Understand-Anything knowledge-base upkeep duty.

nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Compact development-context entrypoint defining the source authority order, the repository shape (shared/backend/frontend/e2e plus docs, plans, qa, deploy), the progressive context-loading protocol driven by pnpm context, and the HANDOFF.md task-state convention.

nodes.name: HANDOFF.example.md
nodes.summary: Tracked template for the git-ignored HANDOFF.md task-state snapshot, covering goal, scope and non-goals, decisions with sources, task-owned files, preserved concurrent changes, QA artifact references, and the next step.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Root orchestration for the whole dev lifecycle: brings up the docker-compose dev stack, runs Drizzle migrations and seeds, starts backend :3001 and frontend :7174 with stale-PID cleanup, and ships the demo deployment to vantai.tingting.vip via GHCR images with rollback capture and public readiness checks.
nodes.languageNotes: 21 make targets sharing a DEMO_COMPOSE indirection so every demo-* target reuses one compose invocation; SSH-driven remote orchestration records pre-cutover image IDs before each deployment for rollback.

nodes.name: ROADMAP.md
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for what to build next: a wave-ordered plan (Foundation shipments entity, Pricing/Fuel, CUS core, Financial Close, Mobile/Director Reporting) mapped onto the 12 Vietnamese PRD modules, with per-wave checklists, a PRD coverage matrix, and open-question tracking against the accepted Q01-Q23 business-logic defaults.

nodes.name: codegraph.json
nodes.summary: Excludes the Understand-Anything scratch directories (.ua/, .trash-*/, .codegraph/) from codegraph indexing so generated knowledge-graph state never pollutes the code intelligence index.

nodes.name: design-qa.md
nodes.summary: Design QA evidence report for the governance-actions compact-row redesign: source-vs-implementation visual comparison at desktop and mobile widths, P1/P2 finding history with the applied fixes, and the final passed verdict with interaction checks.

nodes.name: docker-compose.dev.yml

nodes.name: db
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL 16 dev database with the pgvector extension preinstalled, exposed on host port 5441, backed by the silversea-pgdata named volume, and guarded by a pg_isready healthcheck.

nodes.name: redis
nodes.summary: Redis 7 alpine cache instance for the dev stack, exposed on host port 6391 with a redis-cli ping healthcheck.

nodes.name: adminer
nodes.summary: Adminer database web UI exposed on port 8083, gated on the db service reaching a healthy state before startup.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Monorepo root manifest: delegates dev and setup to make, wires the context-resolver and seed tooling scripts, pins pnpm 10.33, and enforces workspace-wide pnpm dependency overrides (esbuild, undici, socket.io-parser, protobufjs, and more) for supply-chain hygiene.

nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
