Details the Postgres partial-unique-index enum-swap workaround, soft polymorphic carrier columns, and non-waivable photo evidence rules.

nodes.name: 2026-08-08-rbac-menu-restructure-verification.md
nodes.summary: Verification journal for plan 260806-rbac-menu-restructure confirming all 8 role-to-home-route mappings were already implemented (ADMIN/MANAGER to /dashboard, ACCOUNTANT to /accounting, DISPATCHER to /dispatch/master-plan, CUS to /shipments, and so on); only homeForRole() documentation was updated. Records passing typecheck and lint plus the shared getNavItems() data source for mobile parity.

nodes.name: 260728-2327-decorative-at-prefix-login-confusion.md
nodes.summary: Incident journal where a decorative @ prefix on usernames in the desktop and mobile user lists was mistaken for part of the login credential. The fix removed the presentation-only JSX prefixes while keeping the authentication flow and payloads untouched, with a regression test covering both responsive render paths.

nodes.name: 260728-2348-shipment-mobile-bottom-fold.md
nodes.summary: UI-repair journal for the shipments page phone viewport, where the breadcrumb's inherited 44px touch-target height pushed the list footer about 30px below the first fold at 390x844. The narrow fix hides .shipments-page__crumbs below 640px only, preserving shared safe-area and touch rules, with a regression test in ShipmentsPage.test.tsx.

nodes.name: 260729-2038-shipment-operations-workspace.md
nodes.summary: High-severity journal of landing the spreadsheet-driven shipment operations workflow (server-side search, operational create/update fields, register actions, clerk dossier persistence) and the adversarial-review find that clearing cargoMode silently dropped the field instead of nulling it and its LCL dependents. Includes the switch from brittle Puppeteer login automation to seeding real JWTs for browser QA.

nodes.name: 260801-new-flow-default.md
nodes.summary: Journal of removing the old rollout compatibility layer so the customer-service-to-finance flow is the only runtime path, and of the test coupling it exposed: chiho-reconciliation FK teardown ordering and durable-effect-jobs asserting a global singleton. Records the API/UI queue mismatch behind the first E2E failure and an honest full-E2E-still-pending status.

nodes.name: 260803-1758-shipment-milestone-table-overflow.md
nodes.summary: Layout journal for the /shipments desktop table where a long next-milestone label painted past the delivery cell into the status column; the fix renders the milestone once with a title tooltip and an ellipsized two-line split, contained in CSS. Documents the red-green test sequence and Puppeteer geometry evidence showing zero document overflow at 1920, 1024, and 390 pixel widths.

nodes.name: 260804-1920-cus-shipment-closeout-qa-setback.md
nodes.summary: QA-concurrency journal from the CUS shipment workspace delivery (seven-tab strip, required columns, missing-date warning, inline expected-delivery edit): a concurrent full backend pass rebuilt shared build output and restarted the watch process mid-E2E, contaminating the signal. Lesson: serialize backend QA before E2E and treat overlapping runs as invalid.

nodes.name: 260813-1730-cus-readonly-container-detail.md
nodes.summary: Journal of the CUS shipment master boundary rework: the dedicated Chi tiet track was removed so row activation opens a read-only container ledger, with Chinh sua as the explicit edit transition and confirm-before-discard safeguards for unsaved edits. Lists ShipmentsPage tests and the two CUS workspace E2E suites among touchpoints, with 640 frontend tests and 21/21 plus 54/54 E2E results.

nodes.name: 260813-2308-cus-create-e2e-concurrency-setback.md
nodes.summary: Setback journal for a red CUS create-screen full E2E run caused by a Playwright navigation-context race, connection refusals to the local :3001 backend, and a concurrent CUS workspace KeyError('factVersion'). Decision: keep the red artifact authoritative, claim no E2E success, and rerun under a stable backend with no concurrent modifying activity.

nodes.name: 260814-2224-shipment-create-page-containment.md
nodes.summary: Technical journal consolidating shipment creation onto the canonical /shipments/new page, with two boundary lessons: native select options can force grid-track overflow unless constrained at the grid item, and required trade direction must be enforced at the backend dispatch boundary, not only by the frontend form.

nodes.name: 260815-0030-cus-shipment-detail-workboard-lessons.md
nodes.summary: Lessons journal for the CUS shipment-detail workboard: container pagination and search made authoritative at the container query boundary, appointment semantics kept at shipment scope, and optimistic save conflicts returning 409 with refresh, remount, and explicit stale-draft disclosure. Also fixes cell-level content overflow rather than page-level only, and keeps a failed narrow-width E2E artifact visible as a real regression.

nodes.name: 260815-0155-governed-editable-grid-authorities.md
nodes.summary: Design journal for making the shipment tables editable like a spreadsheet without flattening persistence authorities: editors split at shipment, container, and approval boundaries under a seven-column visual grouping, container numbers canonicalized under the transaction lock, and a semantic split between draft-discarding 409 version conflicts and inline 400 validation that keeps the draft.

nodes.name: 260815-1250-dispatch-detail-ui-polish.md
nodes.summary: Presentation-only journal for the /dispatch/detailed-plan polish (dynamic identity Ke hoach chi tiet xe, labelled Vietnamese filters, responsive control sizing) with a review-caught nested filter CSS scope fix. Explicitly records that no business, RBAC, accounting-lock, or dispatch-order contract changed, and that mixed-carrier mutation and driver-notification walkthroughs remain open.

nodes.name: O2C Flow.md
nodes.summary: Vietnamese PRD specifying the Order-to-Cash operation and settlement workflow in five steps (master-data setup, shipment intake, dispatch, field execution, reconciliation/close), including the 5-state shipment lifecycle and 2026-08-01 decisions to drop hard locking and restrict MVP push notifications to driver and dispatcher roles.
nodes.languageNotes: Encodes control points per step: paired-trip toll deduplication, fuel-fraud photo cross-checks, mandatory POD recovery gate before completion, and auto-offset of approved disbursements against advance balances.

nodes.name: O2C dev-rev1.md
nodes.summary: Developer revision of the O2C workflow adding a state machine diagram and per-step Dev Notes: the seven-role permission model, dual supplier payment terms, port lift-price matrix, fuel-surcharge formula, two-level dispatch planning, and boundary contracts for COGS, POD gating, advance offset, and AR/AP snapshot handoff.
nodes.languageNotes: Explicitly defers the `Đã khóa (Locked/Billed)` state and read-only freezing per customer decision; completion pushes a point-in-time snapshot to the debt module and flags records dirty if costs are edited afterward.

nodes.name: business-logic-qa-proposals.md
nodes.summary: Catalog of 23 business-logic questions (Q01–Q23) with TingTing's default proposals, all accepted by SilverSea on 2026-07-27, covering AR credit-limit thresholds, payment allocation, supplier duality, salary-period close, no-invoice disbursements, maker-checker roles, and cross-module timing, plus two approved staging-QA addenda (O01, O02).
nodes.languageNotes: Governed by a configuration-driven rule: monetary thresholds, rates, and schedules must never be hardcoded; each item carries a stable ID and a status lifecycle (pending/accepted/modified/rejected) linked to roadmap waves.

nodes.name: overall-business-workflow-alignment.md
nodes.summary: Evidence-based audit aligning the implementation against the verified source spec: a frozen 27-row OVR authority matrix with PASS/FAIL dispositions, shipment lifecycle traces, an eight-role runtime authority trace, overlapping-plan reconciliation, and the non-pass stop conditions blocking customer cutover.
nodes.languageNotes: Every matrix row cites code, test, and staging evidence; SHA-256 verification of the external source document is recorded, and FAIL rows (pricing preview, fuel anomaly UI, completion actor separation, AP snapshot fail-closed) each map to an owning phase.

nodes.name: quytrinh-o2c-qa-test-plan.md
nodes.summary: Vietnamese master QA plan for the O2C flow: terminology, environment init, account matrix, master-data preflight, evidence worksheet rules, and 20 end-to-end test cases (TC-MO2C-00 through 19) spanning shipment creation, dispatch, driver milestones, e-POD, close, debit-note export, RBAC, and reconciliation sign-off.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a strict verdict model — a run is only PASS when every mandatory case passes, dependency-blocked cases propagate BLOCKED, and SKIP is never allowed as a BLOCKED substitute — plus a five-point reconciliation worksheet and per-run register.

nodes.name: sidebar-organization-by-role.txt
nodes.summary: Sidebar and navigation specification per role (dated 01/08/2026): for each of the seven roles it lists the start page, menu groups, route paths, and visibility rules — e.g. accountants land on /accounting and never see /dashboard or /dispatch, drivers get a bottom mobile bar, and customers use the portal menu.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain-text tabular spec; several entries carry conditional visibility (treasury view and recoverable-costs items shown only when the account is granted the specific permission).

nodes.name: silversea-google-drive.md
nodes.summary: Reference sheet for reading the customer's public SilverSea Google Drive without authentication: folder IDs, curl recipes against the public export endpoints (folder listing, Docs-as-text, Sheets-as-CSV/XLSX, arbitrary file download), the known document inventory, and when gws OAuth is actually required.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents that the unauthenticated Drive REST API returns 403 while Google's public export endpoints work — a practical workaround so agents skip unnecessary OAuth setup.

nodes.name: 00-cross-cutting.md
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting regression suite (HT) with 12 shared acceptance criteria (language, URL-based authorization, audit log, double-submit integrity, currency, datetime, responsive, error recovery, search/export, cross-module reconciliation) plus 23 business-logic questions (Q01-Q23) covering credit limits, payment allocation, maker-checker, period locking, and concurrency.
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Vietnamese; test IDs follow the TC-HT-xx convention shared across the whole regression directory.

nodes.name: 01-module-01-overview-dispatch.md
nodes.summary: Module 01 regression suite covering the operations dashboard, revenue/cost/profit board, trip trend charts, dispatch creation and status tracking, per-trip profit analysis, port/warehouse expense capture, fleet and trailer management, two-way dispatch for the same truck/driver, and trip closing with audit log.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; 52 sections organized as 8 feature groups each with 5-6 TC-M01-xx-xx cases plus an M01 acceptance table.

nodes.name: 02-module-02-pricing-revenue.md
nodes.summary: Module 02 regression suite for pricing and non-transport revenue: fixed customer/route price lists, bulk-cargo weight-based tariffs, automatic revenue calculation from cargo weight, port lift/lower unit-price suggestions, and ancillary revenue tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; smallest module suite at 122 non-empty lines, 5 feature groups with calculation-focused cases.

nodes.name: 03-module-03-cus.md
nodes.summary: Module 03 (CUS customer service) regression suite covering booking intake and shipment-lot profiles, document validation with ISO 6346 container checks, customer progress notifications, delivery confirmation and container return, debit-note issuance, payment confirmation tracking, and disbursement-invoice reconciliation, including customer-portal security cases.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; largest module suite with 53 sections and dedicated customer-portal security (TC-HT-11/12) references.

nodes.name: 04-module-04-disbursement-recovery.md
nodes.summary: Module 04 regression suite for the closed-loop disbursement/recovery flow: lot initiation by CUS or clerk, field-staff pending expenses, consolidating expenses from multiple staff onto one lot, accounting reconciliation and approval with maker-checker, debit-note generation and period locking, and classification of invoiced vs non-invoiced disbursements with the Q13/Q14 thresholds.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; cross-references business questions Q13/Q14 from the cross-cutting doc for expense thresholds and approval tiers.

nodes.name: 05-module-05-ar.md
nodes.summary: Module 05 (accounts receivable) regression suite covering customer debt tracking by debit note, aging classification, credit limits with 80%/100% warning thresholds and over-limit approval, freight-vs-disbursement debt separation, consolidated AR reports, payment allocation by trip or lot, automated dunning, and statement/debit-note export.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; uses a uniform 5-case pattern per feature (normal / no-data / boundary / change-exception-permission / retry-concurrency-consistency).

nodes.name: 06-module-06-ap.md
nodes.summary: Module 06 (accounts payable) regression suite covering fuel-debt tracking, extending payables to shipping lines, truckers, ports, warehouses and services, supplier invoice due-date and payment tracking with prepayment/overpayment handling, and bilateral debt offsetting.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; includes the customer-is-also-supplier (Q08) edge cases for two-way offsetting.

nodes.name: 07-module-07-payroll.md
nodes.summary: Module 07 regression suite for driver payroll and HR: automatic per-trip/base/waiting-day salary calculation, attendance calendars by day type, pay-period closing with labor-cost accounting and controlled reopening, and discipline/deduction management with threshold-based approval tiers.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; period-close semantics (Q10/Q11) tested explicitly — errors block close, post-close changes require adjustment entries.

nodes.name: 08-module-08-driver-app.md
nodes.summary: Module 08 regression suite for the driver mobile app: readable mobile UI, receiving dispatch orders and guidance documents, displaying two orders per day, updating progress and incidental expenses with offline safety, photographing container/seal codes for recognition, and viewing personal payslips and penalties.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; mobile-specific cases include OS font scaling, landscape rotation, slow network, and safe offline queuing.

nodes.name: 09-module-09-field-app.md
nodes.summary: Module 09 regression suite for the forwarder/field-staff mobile app: advance requests and disbursements with maker-checker, selecting lots and recording pending expenses, port lift/lower unit-price suggestions, consolidating multiple staff expenses per lot, and uploading port document photos.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; emphasis on multi-user concurrent submissions and partial-return settlement of shared expenses.

nodes.name: 10-module-10-clerk-app.md
nodes.summary: Module 10 regression suite for the document-clerk app: quick after-hours lot creation on mobile with role checks and midnight boundary cases, an undefined-scope placeholder section, and immediate handoff of lots to dispatch with version-conflict and recall handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; smallest app-module suite, explicitly notes that section 10.2 has no defined product yet.

nodes.name: 11-module-11-finance-pnl.md
nodes.summary: Module 11 regression suite for finance, P&L reporting and the CEO assistant: overall period P&L, per-truck P&L with shared-cost allocation, advance/settlement reports by employee, payment-date capture for customer-term evaluation, the executive cash-flow/two-way-traffic/fleet-efficiency dashboard, and the AI chatbot query endpoint at /api/agent.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; section 11.6 tests the AI assistant including voice input, timezone-sensitive relative dates, and permission-scoped answers.

nodes.name: 12-module-12-fuel.md
nodes.summary: Module 12 regression suite for fuel management and fuel-document digitization: fuel-norm and route-distance configuration, month-end reconciliation of pumped fuel against supplier invoices (including multi-truck invoices), and automatic OCR of pump-column photos with tamper-resistance checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; closed trips must not recalculate when norm configuration changes later — consistency is asserted explicitly.

nodes.name: 13-customer-service-finance-visual-workflow.md
nodes.summary: Visual regression contract tracing the Customer Service to finance flow: an execution contract for the testing agent (no assumed passes, mandatory accounts, viewport rules), then ~50 VIS-CSF cases across booking/CUS handoff, CUS disbursement review, debit notes and AR, AP and treasury, finance dashboards, and responsive/accessibility/error-recovery checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; cases tagged [READ]/[MUTATION] with P0-P2 priorities and an explicit negative-permission matrix.

nodes.name: 14-order-to-cash-workflow.md
nodes.summary: Order-to-Cash end-to-end regression suite covering the full flow: setup and permission matrix (create-only roles, deletion rules, push MVP scope), CUS lot initiation with auto-pricing and fuel surcharge, two-level vehicle allocation with coupled loads, ops/driver execution with fuel-photo EXIF anti-fraud, accounting reconciliation and settlement with AR/AP/VAT snapshots, plus cross-module reconciliation and edge cases.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; includes a supersession note declaring this document replaces older flow specs, and asserts no-freeze semantics (post-completion edits allowed via adjustments).

nodes.name: 15-navigation-menu-by-role.md
nodes.summary: Navigation and menu regression suite per role: five general principles (active-page marking, 44px touch targets, default expanded group, scrollable menu, desktop/mobile parity), then per-role sections for ADMIN, MANAGER, DISPATCHER, ACCOUNTANT, DRIVER, FORWARDER, CLERK and CUSTOMER covering landing pages, menu ordering, capability-gated items, and direct-URL denial.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; maps NP-xx navigation principles to TC-NAV cases and includes a cross-role landing-page summary table.

nodes.name: 16-overall-business-workflow.md
nodes.summary: Executable regression contract for the overall business workflow: execution/status rules, required role fixtures with exact-role caveats, environment commands for local baseline and staged runs, viewport/accessibility/volume settings, financial invariants, an OVR coverage map, and eight mandatory cross-cutting scenarios (actor separation, governed exception close, fail-closed AR/AP capture, concurrency, crash recovery, migration rehearsal, volume, evidence redaction).
nodes.languageNotes: English-language contract unlike the Vietnamese module docs; defines machine-checkable exit criteria and QA artifact naming.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index and handbook for the SilverSea manual website regression plan: how to use the docs, QA role and scope, per-case structure, priorities and result recording, demo accounts, environment/URL map of main screens, directory file structure with a module-to-test matrix, shared acceptance criteria, and recommended smoke/per-module/master-data regression cadence.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; the directory index — every other file in docs/regression-testing is reachable from its structure matrix.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template for the frontend's single environment variable VITE_API_BASE, defaulting to /api so the Vite dev-server proxy forwards API calls to the backend on port 3001.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.dockerignore
nodes.summary: Allowlist-style dockerignore that keeps the monorepo build context intact for pnpm workspace links while sending only files referenced by frontend/Dockerfile: workspace manifests, the shared package sources, and frontend app sources, excluding all test files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the '*' exclude-all-then-reinclude ('!pattern') allowlist idiom, with per-directory re-exclusion of *.test.* and __tests__ files.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Docker build orchestration for the frontend image ghcr.io/4rankng/transting-frontend: the push target creates/reuses a buildx builder, logs into GHCR via gh auth token, and builds+pushes linux/amd64 tags with registry inline cache, while build-local does a fast native-platform build; both run from the repo root against frontend/Dockerfile with a version tag computed by scripts/release-source-tag.mjs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses docker buildx with --cache-from/--cache-to type=inline for registry-layer caching and a shell-out to node scripts/release-source-tag.mjs for deterministic image tags.

nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: Untitled UI component-library registry pin (version 8) that anchors the CLI retrieval workflow used to vendor React PRO component sources into src/components/untitled-ui.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite entry HTML for the TransTing SPA: Vietnamese locale, PWA manifest and iOS Add-to-Home-Screen standalone metadata with PNG apple-touch icons, self-hosted Be Vietnam Pro fonts, and the /src/main.tsx module bootstrap into #root.
nodes.languageNotes: Ships the full iOS standalone meta set (apple-mobile-web-app-capable, black-translucent status bar) because iOS rejects AVIF touch icons, plus viewport-fit=cover for notch safe-area insets.

nodes.name: netlify.toml
nodes.summary: Netlify deploy configuration that runs the production build and rewrites every route to /index.html so the client-side React Router handles SPA navigation.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Frontend package manifest for @tingting/frontend: React 19, Vite 6, Tailwind 4, TanStack Query/Table, react-aria + Radix, and the workspace dependency on @tingting/shared, with scripts for dev, strict builds with bundle-size checks, vitest and Playwright test suites, brand/UI contract checks, and the pinned untitledui@0.1.63 CLI workflow (uui:login/search/add).

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript project config extending the monorepo tsconfig.base.json with react-jsx, noEmit, and path aliases mapping @/* to src/* and @tingting/shared to the shared package sources; includes shared/src while excluding its tests.

nodes.name: adding-a-page.md
nodes.summary: Step-by-step recipe for adding a new frontend route: choosing between pages/features/design-system folders, wiring lazy routes with role guards in App.tsx, building the data layer (shared path constants, api/*Client, qk key factories, hooks), composing DataTable/useTableQueryState UI, and a list of anti-patterns to avoid.

nodes.name: api-layers.md
nodes.summary: Architecture doc describing the two-layer frontend API split — typed domain bundles in src/api/*Client.ts over the singleton fetch transport in lib/api/client.ts — plus the query-key factory (api/keys.ts), hooks layer, endpoint decision flow, and the cursor-pagination invariants that dispatch planning clients must preserve.

nodes.name: design-system.md
nodes.summary: Design-system guide for src/design-system/: catalog of primitives (DataTable, Pagination, form fields, CrudFormModal) and hooks (useTableQueryState, useToken, useAuthedQuery), rules for when to add versus use a primitive, and the control-density and operational-table color contracts (34/40/44px control heights, neutral badge palette, semantic forest/bronze/oxblood statuses).

nodes.name: untitled-ui.md
nodes.summary: Operating manual for vendoring Untitled UI React PRO v8 components: PRO browser-login authentication, pinned CLI scripts for search/add, verified CLI failure modes (--path is src-relative, npm-install step fails benignly in pnpm, overwrite prompts, 429 rate limits), and the agent-browser website-discovery fallback.

nodes.name: Button.css
nodes.summary: Global button styles defining the .btn base class plus primary/secondary/ghost/danger variants, sm/lg/icon sizes, disabled state, and mobile touch-target sizing. Shared by nearly every action surface in the frontend.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BEM double-dash variant classes (.btn--primary); legacy single-dash variants were retired during CTA unification. Touch targets scale via --control-touch-h at <=640px.

nodes.name: ConfirmDialog.css
nodes.summary: Styles the centered confirmation dialog: fixed overlay, 400px content box, semantic icon tiles (danger/warning/primary), message body, and right-aligned action row. Opacity/scale animations are delegated to anime.js spring physics.

nodes.name: Drawer.css
nodes.summary: Styles the right-side slide-over drawer with overlay, sticky header (title/subtitle/close), scrollable body, and footer action bar. Translate animation is handled by anime.js rather than CSS transitions.

nodes.name: DriverTripCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the driver trip list card: route title, meta row, right-aligned salary value, license-plate badge with overflow wrapping, and a status strip rendered as a ::before gradient. Used on driver-facing trip list views.
nodes.languageNotes: Status accent comes from a --strip-top/--strip-bottom gradient on a ::before strip (shared status-strip token pattern) instead of a full-height left border.

nodes.name: EarningsHero.css
nodes.summary: Styles the earnings summary hero with positive (green) and negative (red) variants: gradient background, large tabular value, unit suffix, and tinted icon tile. Serves as the headline metric block on driver earnings pages.

nodes.name: FilterBar.css
nodes.summary: Styles the horizontal filter toolbar: pill-like .filter-tab toggles, icon search input, generic .filter-pill with count badge, and the expense-filters desktop/mobile layout. The base .filter-tab selector also works outside .filter-bar containers.

nodes.name: FuelAllocCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the fuel-allocation highlight card: brand-tinted header with icon, label and large value, plus a compact body list. Tightens padding and font size on mobile.

nodes.name: FwdFilterPills.css
nodes.summary: Styles the forwarder dashboard status filter pills with per-status tinting driven by data-status attributes (CREATED blue, LOCKED purple), active/hover states, status dot, and count badge. Round pills switch to rounded-rect on mobile.
nodes.languageNotes: Status accent colors are deliberately rgb()/rgba() literals tied to semantic statuses rather than hex tokens, per the shared-primitive token contract noted in the header.

nodes.name: InfoRow.css
nodes.summary: Styles label/value info rows in three variants: plain, --feature with a tinted 36px icon tile (accent/info/warn/danger/neutral), and --hero with a large tabular-number value. The workhorse for detail panels and grouped info lists.

nodes.name: Input.css
nodes.summary: Styles the .input form control family: text input with hover/focus/disabled states, icon-affixed variant, auto-growing textarea, and a custom-chevron select. Mobile bump height to touch targets with 16px font to prevent iOS zoom.
nodes.languageNotes: select.input resets native appearance and injects an inline SVG chevron via data-URI background — the generic styling hook, distinct from the UuiSelectField adapter used for dropdowns.

nodes.name: KpiCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the KPI dashboard family: responsive .kpi-grid, .kpi cards with a colored status rail and watermark icon, semantic warn/danger/success/info variants, the legacy .stat-card, .metric-strip label/value blocks, and the trend variant with sparkline plus up/down badges.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-card accent is driven by a --stat-rail custom property consumed by a shared ::before status strip; the trend sparkline hides entirely below 420px rather than shrinking.

nodes.name: Layout.css
nodes.summary: Pure @import barrel that stitches together the app-shell, sidebar, topbar, sidebar-overlay, bottom-nav, and responsive layout sections from ./layout/. Contains no rules of its own; import order defines the cascade order.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS @import must precede all other rules, so this file is an ordering contract: cascade order == import order == the original pre-split file.

nodes.name: Modal.css
nodes.summary: Styles the centered .modal dialog with head/body/foot structure and a mobile bottom-sheet variant (rounded top corners, drag handle bar, safe-area padding, full-width footer buttons). Opacity/scale animation is delegated to anime.js.
nodes.languageNotes: Mobile variant swaps to a bottom sheet using 100dvh, env(safe-area-inset-bottom), and a ::before drag handle; .modal__close composes the shared .btn classes from Button.css.

nodes.name: PageHeader.css
nodes.summary: Styles page-level headers: title/subtitle/actions row, actions-only variant, branded PNG icon chip, two-column detail-grid, fuel-alert status badges, and the trip-detail title/subtitle pair.

nodes.name: Panel.css
nodes.summary: Styles content containers: the .panel with clickable/hover states, legacy .card-shell, .subsection-card callouts with semantic status-strip accents, and the iOS-settings-style .m-group mobile grouped-card pattern with categorical accent strips.
nodes.languageNotes: Callout accents use the canonical 3x20px status-strip ::before (never a full-height left border); the m-group accent selector uses [class~=]/[class*=] attribute matching to apply one shared strip to all accent variants.

nodes.name: PhotoViewer.css
nodes.summary: Styles the full-screen photo lightbox (.pv- prefix): blurred backdrop, top bar with counter/zoom label/actions, transform-ready image stage, prev/next nav arrows, and a mobile variant with safe-area insets and pill-shaped controls. Consumed by trip-detail photos and container cards.
nodes.languageNotes: Image zoom/pan is JS-driven (will-change: transform, touch-action: none); mobile sizing uses env(safe-area-inset-*) and 100dvh math, and Vietnamese-titled buttons are matched via [title^="Đặt"] to hide on phones.

nodes.name: Pill.css
nodes.summary: Styles status indicators: .pill with dot and success/warn/danger/info/neutral tones plus solid and md variants, the legacy .badge-* scale, and the license-plate .plate tag. The shared vocabulary for status cells across tables and heroes.

nodes.name: Table.css
nodes.summary: The shared table stylesheet: .table-wrap/.table-scroll shell with sticky thead, the ancillary-fees grid (fee columns, hover-revealed decision actions, totals row, add-fee row) with a desktop-table-to-mobile-cards swap, base table element styles, the .tt-table premium variant, pagination buttons, and row action icons.
nodes.languageNotes: Column-hiding via nth-child display:none at <=1200px and a full card-based re-layout at <=640px; hover-revealed action triggers also surface on :focus-within for keyboard accessibility.

nodes.name: Toolbar.css
nodes.summary: Styles the sticky content toolbar with grow/spacer helpers and an inline BEM search field with focus-within highlighting. Search stretches full-width on mobile with 16px input font to prevent iOS zoom.

nodes.name: TripHero.css
nodes.summary: Styles the trip-detail hero header: back button, breadcrumb eyebrow, large title row, meta chips (route chip accent-tinted), warning pill, and a dashed-divider actions row that composes Button sm variants.

nodes.name: app-shell.css
nodes.summary: App-shell grid styles: keyboard skip-link, the sidebar+main 100dvh two-column layout, safe-area-aware scrollable app-body with content max-width centering, and the desktop sidebar-collapsed (48px icon rail) state that hides labels, badges, and chevrons.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dvh units with vh fallbacks and max(env(safe-area-inset-*, 0px)) padding for notched devices.

nodes.name: bottom-nav.css
nodes.summary: Mobile-only driver bottom navigation: frosted-glass fixed bar with animated active indicator and icon lift, plus the full mobile user-menu bottom sheet (overlay, drag handle, staggered icon-tile buttons for profile/password/logout) used when the driver sidebar is hidden below 1024px.
nodes.languageNotes: Wrapped almost entirely in one @media (max-width: 1023px) block; staggered sheet-item entrance animations via nth-child animation-delay and cubic-bezier springs.

nodes.name: responsive.css
nodes.summary: Tiny residual responsive-override sheet for the driver portal: safe-area bottom padding on the driver bottom nav and clamp()-based KPI value sizing to prevent mobile text truncation.

nodes.name: sidebar-overlay.css
nodes.summary: Mobile drawer overlay and close-button styles (hidden on desktop), plus the notification drawer item system — section labels, read/unread dots, and message typography for the NotificationBell panel.

nodes.name: sidebar.css
nodes.summary: Main sidebar styles: gradient dark rail with brand block, scrollable sectioned nav with 44px-touch items and active accents, user footer with dropdown menu, and the portal-rendered collapsed-rail tooltip that escapes the sidebar's overflow hidden.

nodes.name: topbar.css
nodes.summary: Topbar styles covering the standard sticky header, the compact driver variant with welcome text, the MonthNavigator trigger popover, wireframe-topbar classes, the notification bell, and the date-chip replacement — all transitioned so the shell stays usable when optional animation code fails to load.

nodes.name: Banner.css
nodes.summary: Styles for the nepo-banner persistent page-top banner: sticky full-width layout with a three-column content/action/close grid, icon and link treatment, and semantic variant accents — built on NEPO tokens instead of daisyUI alerts.

nodes.name: CommandPalette.css
nodes.summary: Command-palette overlay styles: blurred backdrop with fade-in, pop-in palette panel, search input row, scrollable keyboard-navigable result list, and grouped sections — a bespoke NEPO-token implementation of the Tailkit a-c-command-palettes-07 pattern.

nodes.name: EmptyState.css
nodes.summary: Centered empty-state panel styles with accent-soft icon tile, optional illustration, bold title, muted description, and action slot.

nodes.name: HeroKpiRow.css
nodes.summary: Vantai hero KPI row styles for the Debt, Payables, and Forwarder pages: large hero card plus stacked mini KPI cards with status-strip rails (accent/danger/warn), eyebrow/amount/subtitle typography, watermark illustrations, and mobile single-column collapse.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a --stat-rail custom property plus shared ::before strip geometry so semantic variants recolor the status strip with one variable override.

nodes.name: Money.css
nodes.summary: Inline money-value styles where digits and sign inherit the surrounding font size while the currency unit renders at a fixed subtitle size via em-relative scaling, so the same component works in hero headings, line items, and table cells.

nodes.name: Skeleton.css
nodes.summary: Shimmer skeleton loading styles with line/circle/card variants and a prefers-reduced-motion fallback that swaps the animation for a flat background.

nodes.name: Toast.css
nodes.summary: Toast notification styles: fixed bottom-right stacking container, semantic success/error/warning/info icon colors, close button, mobile full-width expansion with 44px touch targets, and reduced-motion resting state — motion itself is driven by anime.js in Toast.tsx.

nodes.name: ActionBar.css
nodes.summary: Styles the trip form's fixed bottom action bar and its danger form-error alert, including a status icon block and sidebar-aware left offset that collapses to full width when the sidebar becomes an overlay at 1023px.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for iOS home-indicator clearance and doubled-class selectors (.tc-action-bar.tc-action-bar) to raise specificity in mobile overrides.

nodes.name: AllowanceSection.css
nodes.summary: Scoped auto-fit two-column grid for trip allowance fields that stays side-by-side at tablet widths and bottom-aligns inputs so multi-line labels keep controls on a shared baseline.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses margin-top:auto inside equal-height stretch columns to pin inputs to the bottom of each grid cell.

nodes.name: CheckboxCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles a full-width clickable checkbox card with label and description text, featuring hover, checked (brand-tinted), and focus-within states built entirely from design tokens.
nodes.languageNotes: Keyboard focus is surfaced via :focus-within on the card wrapper so the native input can remain visually styled by accent-color.

nodes.name: ContainerInstancesCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the flat logistics manifest editor: per-record header rows, identity and seal-number field grids, photo capture lanes with pending/error slot states, inline field-warning strips, and a visually-hidden utility class.
nodes.languageNotes: Container queries (@container max-width 960/640/420px) drive responsiveness instead of viewport media queries, so the manifest reflows based on its own inline size; status-strip tokens render warning markers via ::before.

nodes.name: FuelModeToggle.css
nodes.summary: Styles the AUTO / FLAT_RATE fuel calculation mode toggle as a two-segment control with visually hidden radio inputs and sibling-label styling for checked and focus-visible states.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic accessible radio pattern: the input is collapsed to 1px/opacity 0 and :checked + label / :focus-visible + label selectors drive all visual state.

nodes.name: FuelSection.css
nodes.summary: Minimal auto-fit two-column grid for fuel fields that deliberately keeps the side-by-side layout down to 560px, unlike the global .row-2 which collapses at 1023px.
nodes.languageNotes: minmax(min(100%, 240px), 1fr) pattern prevents grid blowout while allowing graceful single-column fallback.

nodes.name: ImagesNotesCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the trip photo grid (72px thumbnails with hover-reveal remove buttons) and the dashed full-width upload zone with icon, title, subtitle, and format hint slots.
nodes.languageNotes: Remove buttons use 44px hit areas revealed on thumbnail hover, with a :focus-visible fallback keeping them keyboard-accessible.

nodes.name: InputWithPrefix.css
nodes.summary: Input wrapper that reserves right padding on the input and absolutely positions a small prefix/suffix label (such as a currency unit) inside the field.

nodes.name: JourneyLegRow.css
nodes.summary: Styles an individual journey leg card: sequence badge, origin-to-destination route grid with center arrow, two-column compact fields, and a focus-within brand border that stacks vertically below 640px.
nodes.languageNotes: Header comment notes the 640px stacking block was consolidated from two previously duplicated media queries.

nodes.name: JourneyLegsCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the journey legs summary bar (data-font totals in a bordered panel) and the dashed empty state with illustration placeholder, title, and description.

nodes.name: ProgressPills.css
nodes.summary: Styles the compact step progress indicator: a pill container with dot markers in pending, done, and active variants that reorders to a full-width row on mobile.

nodes.name: RouteChips.css
nodes.summary: Styles wrap-friendly suggested-route pill chips with arrow separators and accent-tinted hover state for quick route selection.

nodes.name: SectionDivider.css
nodes.summary: Styles a centered uppercase micro-label divider with flanking hairline rules used to separate trip form sections.

nodes.name: TipCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the informational tip banner using info color tokens with a color-mix derived border and icon slot.

nodes.name: TripChecklistPanel.css
nodes.summary: Styles the right-rail trip completion checklist: clickable items with dot indicators (done/active/pending), name text, and status badges including a red required marker.

nodes.name: TripInfoCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the trip info card's container-instance grid (container type / number / notes columns spanning the parent form grid) with container-query collapse to a single column at 620px and 430px.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS container queries rather than viewport breakpoints so the card reflows against its own rendered width.

nodes.name: TripInstructionsCard.css
nodes.summary: Styles the manager-authored contact and guidance card (.ti-* scoped to avoid collisions), including one-tap reminder chips that append bullet lines to the notes and a single-column collapse below 560px.
nodes.languageNotes: Scoped .ti-* namespace with token fallbacks (e.g. var(--fg-3, #888)) keeps the card independent from global token changes.

nodes.name: TripLegsPanel.css
nodes.summary: Styles the vertical route timeline visualization: origin/destination and mid-stop dot markers with connector lines, stop names, per-leg distance rows, and loaded/empty pill badges.

nodes.name: TripPodSubmission.css
nodes.summary: Styles the proof-of-delivery (chứng từ) submission panel: lifecycle status pills (draft/submitted/accepted/rejected), warn/error/info banners, required markers, file list rows, readiness footer, submit button, and submission history timeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Three-column document grid activates at min-width 700px (desktop-only enhancement); 420px block re-flows heads, files, and actions into single-column grids.

nodes.name: TripSummaryCard.css
nodes.summary: Shared stylesheet for two coexisting summary card families: .tc-summary-card* for the trip create page (status-strip card with big-number total and cost rows) and .tc-totals* for the edit page right rail (revenue hero, fuel/road/salary/other allocation bar with legend, clickable cost rows with breakdowns, and profit display).
nodes.languageNotes: One stylesheet deliberately serves two React components (TripSummaryCard and TotalsPanel); the allocation bar is a pure-CSS segmented chart whose colors mix tokens (#1D4ED8 road, #B45309 salary) with fallback hex values.

nodes.name: DataTable.css
nodes.summary: Styles the shared DataTable design-system primitive: scrolling wrapper, sticky-header handling, density and alignment helpers, and a loading-state animation.

nodes.name: EmptyState.css
nodes.summary: Styles the EmptyState placeholder component with a centered icon/title/description column, action slot, and responsive spacing.

nodes.name: Pagination.css
nodes.summary: Styles the shared Pagination control used as the table footer: page-size selector, page buttons, and prev/next navigation with a mobile breakpoint.

nodes.name: Sparkline.css
nodes.summary: Minimal sizing rules for the inline SVG Sparkline component so it shrinks cleanly inside KPI card meta slots.

nodes.name: Tabs.css
nodes.summary: NEPO-specific extensions layered over the daisyUI .d-tabs base: spacing, count badges, and a plain chip variant, built from design tokens only.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately tokens-only — no Tailwind palette classes or dark: variants since the NEPO theme is light-only.

nodes.name: CrudFormModal.css
nodes.summary: Styles the CrudFormModal create/edit overlay: blurred fixed backdrop, centered dialog panel, and form-layout chrome for config catalog CRUD.

nodes.name: NumberField.css
nodes.summary: Intentionally empty placeholder reserved for number-input-specific tweaks; NumberField reuses the shared TextField.css chrome for its input styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Documented-by-comment empty file: base styles come from TextField.css, keeping a single source of truth for input chrome.

nodes.name: SearchableSelect.css
nodes.summary: Comprehensive BEM-style styling for the searchable dropdown: trigger, chevron, clear button, backdrop, option list with checkmarks, empty and load-more states.

nodes.name: TextField.css
nodes.summary: Base styles for the ds-field text input family: label, input chrome, prefix/suffix slots, error states, and responsive rules.

nodes.name: UuiSelectField.css
nodes.summary: Global skin for the Untitled UI select adapter that replaced every native <select> in the app, enforcing consistent theming and layout on the UUI dropdown.
nodes.languageNotes: Header comment documents the project-wide rule: user-facing UI must never render a native <select> because the macOS picker ignores app theming.

nodes.name: AccountingWorkspacePage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the accounting workspace: period filter bar, KPI grid, two-column workflow launcher cards, and a paginated transport register with sticky table header and a sticky bottom bulk-selection bar. Below 1023px the register table is replaced by scrollable mobile cards across three responsive tiers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses color-mix() over design tokens for alert/status tints and pairs a sticky thead with a sticky bottom selection bar.

nodes.name: AdminAdvanceSettlementsPage.css
nodes.summary: Comprehensive stylesheet for the admin advance-settlements worksheet: KPI row with per-variant selection rings, desktop data-grid header/row/cell system, loading and empty states, footer counts, and a mobile card layout that replaces the grid below 820px.
nodes.languageNotes: KPI (.as-kpi) sizing is deliberately identical to AdminAdvancesPage .adv-kpi for cross-page visual consistency; attention states use rail+ink rather than filled cards.

nodes.name: AdminAdvancesPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the admin advances approval page with a filterable KPI row, desktop grid of advance requests, and mobile card fallback. Delegates page-header typography to global UI.css and reuses shared toolbar/filter classes.
nodes.languageNotes: AdvKPI mirrors the dashboard's .dash-wf .wf-kpi sizing exactly, an intentional cross-page consistency contract.

nodes.name: AdvanceWorkspacePage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the advance workspace shell that hosts the admin-advances and settlements views: heading with governance link, a two-segment view switcher with active accent underline, and flattened panel/KPI surfaces so nested pages read as one hierarchy.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a prefers-reduced-motion guard and an inset box-shadow active indicator on the segmented switcher.

nodes.name: AuditLogPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the audit log viewer: activity timeline dots, HTTP method badges, event tags, avatar color rings, and a full-width list with on-demand detail preview. At 820px the desktop table collapses into a vertical card list with wrapping messages instead of ellipsis.
nodes.languageNotes: Desktop message cells truncate with ellipsis while the mobile card variant wraps — a deliberate density trade-off per breakpoint.

nodes.name: ConfigPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the configuration hub landing cards plus responsive overrides migrated from the old responsive.css: big cards become compact list rows at 1100px and wide CRUD tables gain horizontal scroll at 640px.

nodes.name: CreditOverrideQueuePage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the credit-override approval queue: status badges, filter toolbar, queued request rows, and empty states, with three responsive tiers down to 380px phones.

nodes.name: CustomersPage.css
nodes.summary: Minimal override sheet that makes the customers toolbar transparent on mobile (below 820px) so it sits on the page canvas instead of painting a second white panel against the bordered card list.

nodes.name: DashboardPage.css
nodes.summary: Large stylesheet for the operations dashboard: workflow KPI row, aging donut and bar charts, risk dots, chart legends, and empty states across seven breakpoints. Defines entrance-animation targets whose initial opacity is set from JS (useDashboardAnimations) and a safety net that sizes any SVG missing width/height attributes.
nodes.languageNotes: Chart SVGs fill the card body via a documented opt-out of the SVG dimension safety net; surfaces stay physically still with color/border hover feedback only.

nodes.name: DebtDetailPage.css
nodes.summary: The largest page stylesheet: styles the receivables debt-detail workspace with breadcrumb trail, customer header, account summary strip, aging bar/grid, ledger route groups, grouped ledger layout, and the core ledger table. Shares its export dropdown menu styling with PayableDetailPage and switches to mobile cards across eleven breakpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Export dropdown rules are explicitly shared by DebtDetail and PayableDetail; the ledger table column system is reused by the payable variant of this page.

nodes.name: DebtListPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the debt list page: horizontal hero summary card with watermark-tinted danger/warning KPIs, a filter bar inside the data card, zebra-striped table rows using the canonical 3x20px status-strip indicator, and loading states.
nodes.languageNotes: Row status uses the project's canonical centered 3x20px status strip (::before), not a full-height left border.

nodes.name: DispatchPlanPage.css
nodes.summary: Shared layout shell for both dispatch planning screens (/dispatch master plan and /dispatch-detail): a reading-width container, a --wide variant that opts out of the cap for high-volume worksheets, error/loading banners, and a sticky pinned-footer pagination contract.
nodes.languageNotes: The wide workspace sets container-type: inline-size so inner worksheets can use container queries; pagination goes static below 1100px.

nodes.name: DriverEarningsPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the driver earnings view: payable-salary ledger cards with an honest unpaid-salary disclosure block, a vehicle-reminders strip, and severity indicators using the canonical status-strip pattern.

nodes.name: DriverPenaltyPage.css
nodes.summary: Zone-structured stylesheet for the driver penalty page: status banner, KPI grid reusing the shared .kpi-grid classes, violations data card with violation rows, empty state, and footer note.

nodes.name: DriverTripDetailPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the driver-facing trip detail view, including a timeline section, with a desktop-first min-width 700px layout and refinement tiers down to 320px phones.

nodes.name: DriverTripsPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the driver trips list as bento-style cards: left status strip, route name, salary amount, meta row, and arrow affordance, reusing the shared FwdFilterPills filter bar classes.

nodes.name: ExpenseEntryPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the expense entry form: two-column desktop layout, panel cards, input grid, photo upload zone with thumbnails, and action buttons — the save button intentionally reuses the global .btn--primary instead of a page-scoped style.

nodes.name: ExpenseListPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the expense list worksheet: KPI cards with total/unpaid/paid variants, a dense filter bar, zebra-striped data table with amount cells, status badges, and plate tags, plus a sticky element and mobile card fallback below 1023px.

nodes.name: FinancePage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the finance overview page: summary sections, revenue area chart with path-entrance animation, donut chart with segment hover, top-truck bar chart hover states, chart panel headers, and legends, plus responsive overrides migrated from responsive.css across five breakpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Chart interactions are hover-driven only (segment/bar highlight) with keyframe entrances for the revenue path.

nodes.name: FleetPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the single-page fleet dashboard: two-column trucks + trailers layout, card headers with count pills, plate tags with VN/RM prefixes, driver avatars, trailer type chips, truck+trailer pair display, tire-management affordances, driver mini-search, and table footer legend.
nodes.languageNotes: Also styles the fleet feature card components (TruckCard, TrailerCard, DriverCard) that render inside this page.

nodes.name: ForwarderAdvancesPage.css
nodes.summary: BEM-scoped (`fadv-`) styles for the forwarder advances page: card list matching the ForwarderTripsPage card pattern, create-form panel, empty/loading states, and settlement (hoàn ứng) summary cards, with mobile and prefers-reduced-motion handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Consumes shared tokens from styles/tokens.css; hover states swap icon-tile background to brand accent; fades and float keyframes disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.name: ForwarderSettlementsPage.css
nodes.summary: Vantai design-system styles (`fset-`) for the forwarder settlement list and create form: glassmorphism cards with hover lift, meta rows, breakdown and linked-advance chips, container number badges, and the empty state shared with the create page.
nodes.languageNotes: backdrop-filter blur(12px) saturate(140%) glass cards; color-mix() for tinted chip borders.

nodes.name: ForwarderTripDateRangePicker.css
nodes.summary: Compact popover styles (`ftrip-date-picker`) for the forwarder trip date-range picker: dual trigger buttons, a fixed dialog with range tabs and 7-column month grid, converting to a mobile bottom sheet with safe-area insets.
nodes.languageNotes: Rules packed one-per-line; mobile sheet uses env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 100dvh max-height, and a slide-in keyframe disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.name: ForwarderTripDetailPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles for the forwarder trip detail workspace (`fwd-`): hero header (hidden when embedded), order panel with facts grid, and an expense entry form whose primary/context/invoice grids reflow responsively, plus grouped expense records with fact lists.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses @container breakpoints (860px/520px) scoped to the expense form's inline-size container rather than viewport media queries.

nodes.name: ForwarderTripsPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the ForwarderTrips page through `ops-bill-*` classes: search toolbar with focus ring, result bar, error/empty states with inline CTA, the ops bill table and its wrap, and order-exchange row treatment.
nodes.languageNotes: File name says ForwarderTripsPage but all selectors are ops-bill-prefixed; local --ops-control-height/--ops-surface custom properties scope density overrides to this page.

nodes.name: GovernanceActionsPage.css
nodes.summary: BEM styles (`governance-actions`) for the governance approval queue: hero with refresh action, filter pills, a four-cell summary strip using status-strip markers, and decision cards with approve/reject controls.
nodes.languageNotes: Focus-visible outlines built with color-mix(in srgb, accent 72%, white); status-strip pseudo-element markers follow the project's replacement for left-border callouts.

nodes.name: LoginPage.css
nodes.summary: Split-screen login gateway composed from Untitled UI patterns: a two-column shell pairing an auth panel (grid-paper background, brand bar, centered 420px form) with a navy brand visual panel, collapsing responsively at 1100px and 900px.
nodes.languageNotes: 100dvh heights with 100vh fallbacks, clamp() fluid hero type, and page-scoped --login-navy/--login-signal custom properties.

nodes.name: PayableListPage.css
nodes.summary: Bento-grid styles for the payables list page: hero KPI row, four aging-distribution cards with severity-dotted progress bars (ok/warn/deep/danger), and a full-width data card wrapping the toolbar, table, and mobile card list.
nodes.languageNotes: Aging severity carried by paired modifier classes on dot and bar elements; glass cards use backdrop-filter.

nodes.name: PenaltyPage.css
nodes.summary: Section barrel that only `@import`s the penalty page's split stylesheets (violation-log, violation-types, responsive) in cascade order; contains no direct rules by design.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS @import must precede all other rules, so the barrel enforces import order == cascade order and forbids adding rules inline.

nodes.name: ProfitPage.css
nodes.summary: Twelve-column bento layout for the profit page, restyled to match the dashboard design language: green-gradient hero with net value, breakdown, shareholders, settlement, and history cards that stack to one column below 1100px.

nodes.name: SalaryAttendancePage.css
nodes.summary: Section barrel that only `@import`s the salary attendance page's split stylesheets (hero-metrics, month-nav, calendar, salary-summary, responsive) in cascade order; contains no direct rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Same @import-barrel convention as PenaltyPage.css and TripDetailPage.css.

nodes.name: SettlementPrintPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the settlement detail page (`settlement-detail`) as a clean 860px document that also prints well: header card, info grid, advance rows, an expense grid that replaces tables, plus finalize and expense-editor blocks, with a dedicated print media block.
nodes.languageNotes: A single @media print block adapts the screen document for paper output instead of maintaining a separate print stylesheet.

nodes.name: ShipmentDetailPage.css
nodes.summary: Read-only shipment detail styles (`shipment-detail`): stacked cards in a responsive grid (two-column above 900px) mirroring the DebitNote/Trip panel aesthetic, with auto-fit definition-list field grids, status line, version pill, and loading/empty states.

nodes.name: ShipmentsDetailPage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the shipments-detail container-ledger worksheet: a five-filter toolbar normalized across UUI and native controls, a four-cell container summary strip with attention highlight, and a fixed-layout ledger table with sticky thead, import/export direction pills, and missing-date row warnings.
nodes.languageNotes: container-name/container-type inline-size plus a :has(tbody > tr:nth-child(2)) gate pins pagination only for multi-row desktop ledgers; sticky thead offsets the scrollport padding via --sticky-thead-top.

nodes.name: ShipmentsPage.css
nodes.summary: The largest page stylesheet: styles the shipments worksheet (`shipments-page`, `cus-worksheet-toolbar`) with a six-filter toolbar that re-skins shared UUI controls (inputs, selects, clear buttons, primary buttons), search field, and the worksheet table chrome beneath.
nodes.languageNotes: Page rules arrange the toolbar while shared UUI size variants own control density — a deliberate layering noted in-source; page overrides neutralize UUI shadows and borders for the flat worksheet look.

nodes.name: SupplierListPage.css
nodes.summary: Flat information-dense supplier worksheet (`suppliers-page`) matching the dispatch table language: sticky thead with per-column type scales, hover rows, bottom-pinned pagination, and a two-column supplier form grid for the create/edit modal.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of !important to win specificity over the vendored component-table styles; ops-table-* tokens drive header/cell typography.

nodes.name: TripCreatePage.css
nodes.summary: Bento-layout styles scoped to `.tc-create-wrap` for the trip create page only: a light operational hero that re-skins the shared `tc-` header primitives, with the edit page deliberately keeping its legacy layout in TripEditPage.css.

nodes.name: TripDetailPage.css
nodes.summary: Section barrel that only `@import`s the trip detail page's split stylesheets (header, bento-cards, pnl-fuel, journey-legs, details, responsive) in cascade order; contains no direct rules.

nodes.name: TripEditPage.css
nodes.summary: Soft-bento two-column styles for the trip edit page (`tc-`) with a sticky right rail, brass-accent hero header with gradient hairline, and status pills; refines card chrome and entrance choreography over the shared TripForm primitives.
nodes.languageNotes: Redefines several tc-page-head/tc-status-pill rules from TripForm.css for the Deep-Luxe brass + Forest Sage skin; slate-token status dot colors per trip state.

nodes.name: TripForm.css
nodes.summary: Shared cross-page primitives for the trip form (`tc-`): page header and back button, the collapsible card system with rotating chevrons, required/optional badges, and auto-fit form row/column layouts — imported by both TripCreatePage and TripEditPage before their page-specific CSS.
nodes.languageNotes: tc-form-row uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr)) so rows self-wrap without page-level breakpoints; collapsed cards drop their bottom border to read as a single pill.

nodes.name: TripListPage.css
nodes.summary: Section barrel for the trips list page: contains no rules, only ordered @import statements pulling the six trip-list/* section stylesheets (hero metrics, filters, table, extras, mobile cards, responsive).
nodes.languageNotes: Barrel pattern with a documented invariant: CSS @import must precede all rules, so cascade order equals import order and rules must live in section files.

nodes.name: TruckTiresPage.css
nodes.summary: Page-scoped stylesheet (146 selectors) for the N1 tire-management surface covering tables, position pickers, dialogs, and supplier pickers with two responsive breakpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Enforces a no-!important discipline per its header comment, relying on page-scoped .ttp- class specificity.

nodes.name: WorkflowFinance.css
nodes.summary: Dense minified stylesheet shared by finance workflow surfaces: status pills, money grids, coordination timeline, profitability tables, and summary cards with seven media breakpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-line minified rule format with semantically named state pills (eligible/blocked/ready_for_review) driven by CSS custom properties.

nodes.name: payables-fuel-invoices.css
nodes.summary: Styles the payables fuel-invoices panel: four-column summary cards, invoice detail hero with metrics, editor allocation cards, and banner states.

nodes.name: SalaryPeriodConfigPage.css
nodes.summary: Scoped styles for the salary period config page: wrapper spacing around the default card plus a CrudTable section with a keyframe and two responsive breakpoints.

nodes.name: config-list.css
nodes.summary: Shared config list-row styles for inline (non-CrudTable) catalog pages: hover-revealed desktop actions, tap-to-edit mobile rows, and column layouts for code/name/city/notes fields.
nodes.languageNotes: Comment documents a dual interaction contract: actions reveal on row hover at desktop width but stay always-visible with full-row tap-to-edit on mobile.

nodes.name: config-page.css
nodes.summary: Shared elegance pass scoped under .cfg-page for all /config/* surfaces (150 selectors, 9 breakpoints): tighter CrudTable density, unified toolbar, empty states, and inline meta pills.
nodes.languageNotes: Everything nests under a .cfg-page scoping root so the polish cannot leak outside /config/* routes.

nodes.name: debit-note-template-editor.css
nodes.summary: Largest stylesheet in the config area (238 selectors): full-page debit-note template editor with topbar, drag canvas, editable input overlays, column designer/inspector, alignment and color controls, and 9 responsive breakpoints.

nodes.name: responsive.css
nodes.summary: Responsive section of the penalty discipline surface: collapses the two-column layout, restacks log and violation-type panels, and adjusts typography across five breakpoints.

nodes.name: violation-log.css
nodes.summary: Core layout for the penalty discipline dashboard: page scaffold, entry cards, and the driver violation log list with 69 desktop-first selectors.

nodes.name: violation-types.css
nodes.summary: Styles the violation-types management panel: empty state, type cards, and an entry keyframe, imported third in the PenaltyPage.css section barrel.

nodes.name: calendar.css
nodes.summary: Page layout and calendar grid styles for the salary & attendance surface: 1180px two-column scaffold, day cells, and attendance state styling with three breakpoints.

nodes.name: hero-metrics.css
nodes.summary: Defines the page's local charcoal/green design tokens and styles the hero KPI strip; imported first in the SalaryAttendancePage.css section barrel.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares five local CSS custom properties on .salary-page (charcoal gradient stops) rather than global tokens, keeping the hero palette page-scoped.

nodes.name: month-nav.css
nodes.summary: Styles the centered month navigation strip with prev/next controls and a mobile breakpoint.

nodes.name: responsive.css
nodes.summary: Mobile redesign at 768px and below that replaces the calendar grid with a vertical day-list, horizontal-scroll driver strip, and collapsible salary summary.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a desktop-hidden pattern: mobile-only elements stay display:none above 768px and the calendar grid is swapped for a day-list below it.

nodes.name: salary-summary.css
nodes.summary: Styles the right-sidebar salary summary card: sidebar column, summary area sections, and an entry keyframe.

nodes.name: bento-cards.css
nodes.summary: Defines the TripDetailPage two-column bento layout (fluid main column plus a 340px sticky rail) and the .card chrome used by its KPI strip, journey summary, and side-rail widgets. Largest section of the trip-detail stylesheet, imported second in the TripDetailPage.css barrel.

nodes.name: details.css
nodes.summary: Holds page-level helpers extracted from TripDetailPage inline styles: loading guard, error banner, notes card, and action-panel buttons. Bridges the .card chrome from bento-cards.css with the .tc-card chrome from TripEditPage.css.

nodes.name: header.css
nodes.summary: Carries the header chrome unique to TripDetailPage — breadcrumb trail, customer name row, action cluster, and route chips — while duplicating the shared .tc-page-head title and status-pill rules so the detail hero renders without importing TripEditPage.css.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately duplicates .tc-page-title/.tc-page-sub/.tc-status-pill rules from TripEditPage.css because TripDetailPage.css does not import it; the comment mandates keeping the two blocks in sync.

nodes.name: journey-legs.css

nodes.name: pnl-fuel.css

nodes.name: filters.css

nodes.name: mobile-cards.css

nodes.name: responsive.css
nodes.summary: Responsive collapse rules for TripListPage: metric grid drops to two columns at 1100px, quick-edit mode restyles the table chrome at 1680px, and phone breakpoints swap the table for the mobile card list. Imported last in the page barrel so overrides win the cascade.

nodes.name: table-extras.css

nodes.name: table.css

nodes.name: animations.css
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for shared @keyframes (fade-up, fade-in, and nine more entrance/exit/attention animations), driven by the vantai motion tokens declared in tokens.css. Consolidates previously scattered keyframe definitions.

nodes.name: base.css
nodes.summary: Element-level resets and document scaffolding: border-box sizing, full-height html/body/#root, body font defaults, and a :has()-based rule that pins the authenticated shell as the sole scroll surface. Guarded by base.test.ts and the control-density contract test.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the modern :has() selector to detect when the authenticated .app shell is mounted and lock the document root's overflow, preventing double scroll surfaces.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Loads the Untitled UI theme via @import "./theme.css" immediately after tokens.css so its :root variables win the cascade over daisyUI, then registers Tailwind plugins (typography, react-aria-components, animate), custom variants, and custom utilities like scrollbar-hide.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind v4 style: @plugin directives and @utility/@custom-variant at-rules replace the legacy tailwind.config.js; the file's position in index.css is load-bearing for variable cascade order.

nodes.name: operational-table-typography.css
nodes.summary: Declares the ops-table typography contract: a set of --ops-table-* size/line-height/weight custom properties that data-dense grids (ShipmentsPage, MasterPlanGrid, DetailedPlanGrid, SupplierListPage) map their primary/supporting/meta/note roles onto instead of inventing per-route font scales.

nodes.name: responsive.css
nodes.summary: Shared responsive overrides for the app shell, generic components, and utilities at tablet (1023px), phone (640px), and narrow-phone (420px) breakpoints. Must be imported LAST in index.css so these rules win over per-component stylesheets, a constraint enforced by multiple styles contract tests.

nodes.name: theme.css
nodes.summary: Untitled UI v8 Tailwind @theme block: the largest stylesheet in the frontend, mapping Be Vietnam Pro font families, the text-size ladder, breakpoints, radius and shadow scales, and the full base/utility/component color palette to Tailwind theme variables.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind v4 @theme at-rule: every declaration generates both a CSS variable and a matching utility class, which is why component colors, property colors, and dark-mode variants each get their own section.

nodes.name: tokens.css
nodes.summary: Root of the style chain: imports Tailwind, registers daisyUI under a `d-` prefix to avoid class collisions, defines the custom `nepo` daisyUI theme, and declares the hand-crafted :root design tokens (deep-emerald primary, ink scale, font, and motion variables) mirrored by theme.css. Pinned by three styles contract tests.
nodes.languageNotes: DaisyUI is namespaced with prefix: "d-" so its .btn/.badge/.modal components cannot collide with the project's pre-existing custom classes of the same names.

nodes.name: typography.css
nodes.summary: Typography utility classes (.typo-display through .typo-caption) composing the display font, font-size scale, weights, and ink colors from tokens.css into named heading and body text styles.

nodes.name: utilities.css
nodes.summary: Layout utilities (.row-2, .row-3, .stack, .section-gap) and the shared [class$="__crumbs"] breadcrumb styling that any page mounting the Breadcrumbs component picks up automatically; also holds the legacy mobile-card classes checked by the mobile-card-interaction contract test.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an attribute-substring selector [class$="__crumbs"] so every page-level breadcrumb variant inherits shared spacing without per-page rules.

nodes.name: context-manifest.json

nodes.name: hooks.json

nodes.name: config.json

nodes.name: understand-staleness.sh
nodes.summary: Fail-safe Stop hook that compares the knowledge base's recorded git commit in meta.json against HEAD and, when stale and auto-update is enabled, injects an instruction to run the Understand-Anything incremental update flow.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports HOOK_CTX as a real environment variable before invoking node — passing it after `-e` as argv leaves process.env.HOOK_CTX undefined and silently drops the injected context.

nodes.name: drizzle.config.ts

nodes.name: fix-esm-imports.js

nodes.name: model.conf

nodes.name: policy.csv

nodes.languageNotes: Uses //-style comments inside a CSV policy file to record decisions such as keeping dispatch resources separate from broad shipment access.

nodes.name: schema 2.ts

nodes.name: resolveImport

nodes.name: walkDir

nodes.name: canonicalizeRole
nodes.summary: Maps a role string to its canonical modern form — CLERK to CUS, FORWARDER to OPS — passing every other role through unchanged.

nodes.name: isLegacyRole

nodes.name: getModernRole
nodes.summary: Explicit branch mapping of legacy role names to their modern equivalents, returning any other role unchanged.

nodes.name: areRolesEqual

nodes.name: getRoleAliasMappings

nodes.name: dispatcher-catalog-read-rbac.test.ts

nodes.languageNotes: Loads the production Casbin model.conf + policy.csv directly via newEnforcer, so the test doubles as a policy-file parse smoke check.

nodes.name: gps-admin.rbac.test.ts
nodes.summary: Casbin RBAC test for the office-only GPS admin backfill/recapture surface: ADMIN (wildcard) and MANAGER are allowed, while ACCOUNTANT, DRIVER, and FORWARDER are denied write access.

nodes.name: gps-settings-schema.test.ts

nodes.name: m25-ancillary-revenue.test.ts
nodes.summary: Validates the M2.5 ancillary revenue schema shape: positive and zero amounts are valid, negative amounts pass the schema (a CRUD hook enforces the mandatory note), all four type values are accepted, and a missing customerId is rejected.

nodes.name: o2c-ar-snapshot.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the O2C accounts-receivable snapshot canonical cost hash: identical payloads hash stably, cost/revenue edits and added expenses change the hash, and expense row order does not (rows are sorted by id before hashing).
nodes.languageNotes: Builds the canonical hash with node:crypto createHash('sha256') over a JSON payload whose expense rows are id-sorted first, guaranteeing order-independence.

nodes.name: o2c-rev1.migration-safety.test.ts
nodes.summary: Migration safety test that reads the Drizzle baseline SQL (0000_flexible-baseline.sql) and migration journal to assert the consolidated O2C baseline is preserved before ordered additive migrations, O2C identity fences remain unique indexes, and lifecycle values stay flexible text without CHECK or foreign-key ownership.
nodes.languageNotes: Static-analysis style test: parses the Drizzle _journal.json and reads migration SQL files from disk rather than executing against a live database.

nodes.name: q18-locked-write-boundary-exhaustive.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exhaustive governance test that parses production TypeScript with the compiler API to prove the Q18 locked-entity write boundary: every one of 16 terminal financial/operational entities appears exactly once in LOCKED_ENTITY_BOUNDARIES, terminal states and direct-write rejection bind to concrete production declarations, each governed action carries entity-specific immutable evidence with executable proof, the shared checker/approver path is bound, and no reopen action exists for irreversible terminal states.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the TypeScript compiler API (ts.createSourceFile + AST visitors) to bind governance manifest entries to real declarations and named tests in production source, turning the manifest into a self-verifying contract.

nodes.name: revenue-schema-override.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests updateTripFiguresSchema's revenue/splits mutual exclusion: revenue sent together with both splits (or with only one split) is rejected, while revenue-only, splits-only, and a single explicit-zero split with revenue omitted are accepted.

nodes.name: shipment-rbac.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Casbin RBAC test for the shipments surface across four describe blocks: CUSTOMER stays portal-only (read/write customer_portal, denied shipments/trips/financial), CUS document clerks get shipment read/write but no delete/trips/financial/users/gps-admin, existing roles are unchanged (regression guard), and MANAGER/ACCOUNTANT get shipment read/write with delete reserved to MANAGER.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads the real casbin model.conf/policy.csv via newEnforcer; the file header notes it doubles as a smoke check that policy.csv comment lines are not misparsed as policy rows.

nodes.name: tire-position-label.test.ts
nodes.summary: Small Zod schema test asserting tireSchema accepts and trims a custom typed tire position label.

nodes.name: tire-transfer-schema.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests transferTireSchema for moving a mounted tire to another vehicle: accepts a truck target with position or a trailer target without one, rejects payloads with no vehicle target, and coerces numeric ids arriving as form strings.

nodes.name: trip-status-machine.test.ts
nodes.summary: Data-driven test suite for the trip status transition matrix documented in docs/flows/01-TRIP_LIFECYCLE.md and encoded in trip-status-machine.service.ts: every from-to combination is covered with no duplicates, IN_TRANSIT dispatch / COMPLETE / CANCEL require ADMIN or MANAGER (COMPLETED is the single terminal posting state; reopen only via governed TRIP_REOPEN), DRIVER and ACCOUNTANT cannot dispatch/complete/cancel, and standard, reopen, and re-dispatch lifecycles are exercised.
nodes.languageNotes: The service function is tightly coupled to its DB transaction, so the business rules are tested as a pure transition matrix rather than by calling the service directly.

nodes.name: nginx-frontend.conf
nodes.summary: Nginx server config for the containerized frontend SPA: gzip compression, security headers (X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy), 1-year immutable caching for Vite-hashed static assets, and an SPA fallback serving index.html for all other routes.
nodes.languageNotes: Cache busting relies on Vite content-hashed filenames, which is why static assets can be marked immutable for a year while index.html is always re-fetched.

nodes.name: nginx-host-vantai.conf
nodes.summary: Host-level nginx reverse proxy for vantai.tingting.vip: routes /api/ and the /socket.io/ assistant transport (WebSocket upgrade, 300s timeouts for long multi-tool turns) to the backend on 127.0.0.1:3090, / to the frontend container on 3000, /adminer/ to 8080, serves /uploads/ from disk, and terminates TLS via Certbot-managed blocks.
nodes.languageNotes: The /socket.io/ location must stay above location / or the polling handshake resolves to the SPA's index.html and the assistant never connects; SSL lines are Certbot-managed and must not be hand-edited.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Deployment orchestration Makefile for the vantai.tingting.vip demo server with six targets: deploy (backend+frontend), deploy-backend (pull image, force-recreate, run drizzle-kit migrate, prune), deploy-frontend, adminer-on/adminer-off (compose profile toggle for the DB GUI), and prune; all driven over SSH against /opt/vantai using docker compose with deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs migrations inside the freshly pulled image before cutover (`compose exec -T backend npx drizzle-kit migrate`), so schema changes apply ahead of the new code going live.

nodes.name: QA-20260731.txt
nodes.summary: Vietnamese-language customer decision questionnaire (4 main questions + 1 sub-question) blocking product scope: legal e-invoice vs Debit Note as the single AR record, minimal treasury platform scope, four distinct CUS customer-communication event types, personnel attachment (dispatcher confirmation, versioned sales assignment, one shared financial version code for 8-dimension P&L), and read/request-only CUS clerk permissions. Each question documents the cost of choosing wrong.

nodes.name: 260816-1110-dispatcher-resource-catalogs.md
nodes.summary: Engineering journal for the shipped DISPATCHER resource-catalog pages (commit a40aeed) recording four lessons: casbinAuthz('config') is an /api catch-all so one grant opens every mounted GET, backend pagination defaults silently break page math unless clients pin limit to pageSize, /api/catalogs/bootstrap lacks a Casbin gate, and pre-existing dirty trees bite at commit time. Lists open follow-up tickets.

nodes.name: staging-redeploy-runbook.md
nodes.summary: Copy-pasteable runbook to finish the vantai.tingting.vip staging redeploy blocked on two operator credential issues (missing ghcr write:packages scope; server compose pulling Docker Hub images while the repo pushes GHCR). Documents the 156-vs-174 migration gap, Option A (move server to GHCR, recommended) vs Option B (keep Docker Hub), post-deploy application of the 8 Long Minh factory sites seed, verification queries, and rollback notes.
